item.description: OpenAI introduced a biodefense action plan in June 2026 centered on its AI model GPT-Rosalind, designed to support biological research and improve pandemic preparedness. The plan aims to strengthen biological security by enabling earlier threat detection, faster countermeasure development, and coordinated crisis response. GPT-Rosalind, released in April 2026, supports research in biology, drug discovery, and medicine, reflecting OpenAI's commitment to advancing health outcomes. The biodefense initiative focuses on equipping trusted developers with advanced AI tools while establishing safeguards and governance for their responsible use to build a more resilient biological future.

item.title: OpenAI updates GPT-Rosalind with enhanced biological reasoning, medicinal chemistry, genomics, and experimental workflow support for life sciences research [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: OpenAI has released an updated version of GPT-Rosalind, a model designed for enterprise-scale life sciences research. The new capabilities include improved performance in medicinal chemistry, genomics analysis, and experimental workflows, leveraging GPT-5.5's advanced coding and tool-use features to support complex drug discovery tasks. The update was evaluated using LifeSciBench, a benchmark developed to assess models on key life sciences research workflows such as evidence handling, scientific reasoning, and experimental validation. GPT-Rosalind demonstrated broad gains across these areas, aiding researchers in tasks like data synthesis from diverse biological sources and troubleshooting wet lab experiments. The model is now available in research preview to eligible organizations worldwide through a trusted-access deployment.

item.title: Wasmer uses Codex with GPT-5.5 to build a Node.js runtime for edge computing, cutting development time from one year to two weeks [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: Wasmer developed Edge.js, a JavaScript runtime that runs Node.js workloads inside a WebAssembly sandbox for edge computing, using Codex powered by GPT-5.5. This approach accelerated their development speed by 10 to 20 times, enabling a small team to complete a project that would have otherwise taken a year in just two weeks. The Wasmer team leveraged Codex throughout the project lifecycle, from architecture to debugging, benefiting from its ability to reason across languages and identify low-level bugs. This breakthrough allowed Wasmer to become the first cloud host to offer full Node.js support at the edge, opening possibilities for more ambitious projects in the future.

item.title: OpenAI proposes a federal blueprint for democratic governance of frontier AI, emphasizing safety, resilience, and national security in the US [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: OpenAI has released a blueprint outlining how the United States can establish a durable federal framework to govern increasingly capable frontier AI systems. The plan focuses on building a national framework aligned with emerging state laws, strengthening the Center for AI Safety and Innovation (CAISI) as the primary federal institution, and mobilizing a resilience strategy to address national security and public safety challenges posed by advanced AI. The blueprint builds on recent state-level initiatives such as California's SB 53, New York's RAISE Act, and Illinois's SB 315, as well as the White House's executive order on Promoting Advanced Artificial Intelligence Innovation and Security. OpenAI emphasizes the need for a federal framework that can evolve alongside AI technology to ensure safe and responsible development.

item.title: OpenAI releases public policy agenda outlining AI safety, user protection, workforce transition, and global standards priorities [ * ] [ ◻ ]
item.description: OpenAI has published its public policy agenda focused on ensuring artificial general intelligence benefits all humanity. The agenda emphasizes AI safety, protecting young users, managing workforce changes due to AI, and establishing global standards to maximize societal benefits. The agenda outlines OpenAI's core principles including democratization, empowerment, universal prosperity, resilience, and adaptability. It supports state and federal efforts in the US to create safety frameworks for advanced AI models and advocates for international cooperation on AI standards. OpenAI also highlights its commitment to broad user accessibility and engagement with governments and civil society to shape policies that advance safe and equitable AI deployment.

item.title: Travelers deploys AI-powered Claim Assistant nationwide using OpenAI to handle surge in auto insurance claims [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: Travelers has launched an AI-powered Claim Assistant developed with OpenAI to help customers file auto insurance claims through natural conversation. The tool operates 24/7, guiding users through first notice of loss, answering policy questions, and submitting claims without wait times, even during catastrophe events. After initial deployment in eight states, Travelers expanded the assistant nationwide within two months, with 85-90% of customers completing claims via AI. This system allows claim professionals to focus on complex cases while managing high claim volumes efficiently.

item.title: OpenAI launches ChatGPT Sites for creating and sharing lightweight internal websites and apps using Codex [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
item.description: OpenAI has introduced ChatGPT Sites, a feature within the Codex desktop app that enables users to create, customize, and deploy lightweight internal websites or apps for specific team workflows. These sites can serve as launch trackers, dashboards, calculators, or onboarding pages, providing a centralized place for teams to access and interact with relevant information. Users describe their needs to Codex, which builds and deploys the site within the same workspace, including hosting, access controls, storage, and database support. The feature supports iterative development through user feedback and allows sharing with specific people or groups, with enterprise admins controlling availability. While sites cannot currently connect to live data directly, users can automate updates through separate workflows to keep information current.

item.title: OpenAI launches new role-specific Codex plugins and interactive sites to enhance productivity across analysts, marketers, designers, investors, and other professionals [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: OpenAI has introduced new role-specific plugins, interactive websites, and annotations for Codex to support a wider range of professionals beyond developers, including analysts, marketers, designers, investors, and bankers. These tools aim to integrate Codex with existing workflows and popular apps, enabling users to create reports, dashboards, creative assets, sales materials, prototypes, and investment analyses more efficiently. The update includes six new plugins tailored to specific roles, covering data analytics, creative production, sales, product design, public equity investing, and investment banking, with plans for more plugins in areas like corporate finance and legal. Additionally, Codex now supports creating and sharing interactive websites and apps within workspaces, allowing teams to collaborate on dashboards, project boards, and review spaces via URL sharing.

item.title: OpenAI calls for global AI Safety Institute to enhance youth safety and opportunities at upcoming G7 Summit [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
item.description: OpenAI is advocating for international collaboration to improve safety and opportunities for young people using AI technologies. The organization proposes establishing a dedicated global AI Safety Institute to develop safeguards, standards, and support systems tailored to youth. OpenAI plans to discuss this initiative at the G7 Leaders' Summit in Évian, France, emphasizing the need for sustained global coordination beyond single events. The proposed institute would facilitate ongoing cooperation among governments, researchers, civil society, and industry to share evidence, develop guidance, and raise safety standards for youth AI use worldwide. The institute would build on existing efforts like Common Sense Media's Youth AI Safety Institute and OpenAI's partnerships with educators and researchers, including studies on Estonia's national ChatGPT rollout in schools. OpenAI stresses that companies should implement age-appropriate protections, conduct regular youth safety risk assessments, and provide accessible parental controls and clear information about AI's benefits and risks for young users.

item.title: OpenAI says Codex is evolving into a productivity tool for knowledge workers beyond developers, with over 5 million weekly users and growing use in research, data analysis, and workflow automation [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: OpenAI released a report showing that Codex, initially a coding tool, is now widely used by knowledge workers to automate routine tasks, accelerate work, and reduce friction across industries. The user base has grown more than sixfold since February 2026, with knowledge workers making up about 20 percent and growing rapidly. Knowledge workers use Codex for creating reports, spreadsheets, presentations, contracts, and increasingly for research, data analysis, and building lightweight tools without engineering support. Users often run multiple tasks in parallel, which may enable them to take on more ambitious projects and expand their roles. Codex helps coordinate work across systems and teams, improve deliverables, and streamline review and approval processes.

item.title: OpenAI outlines AI policy stance, denies political PAC involvement, and emphasizes transparency and independence from external political groups [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
item.description: OpenAI has detailed its approach to AI policy and political advocacy, emphasizing the importance of transparent communication about its values and policy positions. The company states it has not formed or funded any political action committees (PACs) or made donations to political campaigns, and that employee political activities are personal and separate from the company. The company also addressed questions about the political group Leading the Future (LTF), clarifying that involvement by its co-founder Greg Brockman and his wife is personal and not representative of OpenAI. OpenAI stresses that no external political group speaks for the company and advocates for thoughtful AI regulation, safety standards, public accountability, and broad access to AI benefits through direct and transparent engagement.

item.title: OpenAI breaks ground on 1GW Stargate data center in Michigan with community and labor partnerships [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: OpenAI has started construction on The Barn, a 1 gigawatt data center campus in Saline, Michigan, aiming to build AI infrastructure while supporting local communities and workers. The project includes commitments to protect local residents from infrastructure costs, safeguard water resources, and create thousands of union construction and permanent jobs. The initiative involves partnerships with Oracle, Related Digital, Walbridge, and local government, contributing $10 million to community improvements and projecting $1 billion in tax revenue over the lease term. OpenAI will also provide up to $45 million in Codex credits to over 400,000 Michigan students and collaborate with state agencies on AI literacy and workforce training programs to prepare residents for AI-related jobs. This project reflects Michigan's industrial heritage and aims to catalyze a new era of technology-driven economic growth rooted in skilled labor and community investment, aligning with broader state strategies for education and workforce development.

item.title: OpenAI frontier models and Codex become generally available on AWS, enabling enterprise AI deployment within existing AWS security and governance frameworks [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: OpenAI has made its frontier models and Codex generally available on Amazon Web Services (AWS), allowing enterprises to integrate these AI tools into their existing AWS environments with familiar security, compliance, and procurement workflows. This integration aims to reduce barriers to AI adoption by enabling faster transition from evaluation to production using AWS-native controls. The offering includes OpenAI models and Codex on Amazon Bedrock, supporting both commercial and GovCloud regions. Customers like Amgen and Autodesk are exploring these capabilities to enhance scientific research and design workflows within secure and governed AWS infrastructures. OpenAI and AWS plan to expand these capabilities further, including future releases like Daybreak, which focuses on cybersecurity applications to help organizations adopt advanced AI securely and efficiently.

item.title: Boston Children's Hospital integrates OpenAI's AI across clinical and operational workflows, diagnosing over 40 rare diseases and saving 60,000 staff hours [ ! ] [ ⬢ ]
item.description: Boston Children's Hospital has embedded OpenAI's artificial intelligence technology into its clinical and administrative operations to improve pediatric care, particularly for complex and rare conditions. This integration has helped diagnose more than 40 previously unresolved rare diseases while reducing operational costs and saving approximately 60,000 staff hours. The hospital developed an enterprise AI layer that supports research, clinical decision-making, and administrative tasks, enabling rapid deployment of AI tools tailored to various roles. AI automations now manage supply chain processes, surgical scheduling, and clinical data synthesis, contributing to over $7 million in redeployed labor. This approach addresses both the cognitive limits of clinicians and the administrative burdens faced by staff, enhancing care delivery and operational efficiency.

item.title: Braintrust uses Codex with GPT-5.5 to convert customer feature requests into preview code branches within minutes, accelerating development and feedback [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: Braintrust engineers have integrated Codex powered by GPT-5.5 into their workflow to rapidly transform customer feature requests into working code previews. This approach enables the team to create preview branches in minutes, allowing real-time iteration and faster feedback loops with customers. Within one month, half of Braintrust's engineering team adopted Codex, which founder and CEO Ankur Goyal credits with significantly speeding up coding and experimentation. The increased speed allows engineers to define problems, run autonomous tests in sandbox environments, and quickly move from ideas to solutions, enhancing their ability to solve customer problems efficiently.

item.title: OpenAI launches Rosalind Biodefense to provide trusted developers and U.S. government partners access to GPT-Rosalind for biodefense and pandemic preparedness [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: OpenAI has introduced Rosalind Biodefense, a program granting vetted developers and select U.S. government collaborators access to GPT-Rosalind, its advanced AI model for life sciences research. The initiative aims to support biodefense, public health, and pandemic preparedness by enabling the development of AI-powered tools for early detection, epidemiological modeling, and medical countermeasures. This effort builds on OpenAI's ongoing work to deploy AI safely in biology, including layered safeguards and partnerships with public-sector organizations. Rosalind Biodefense sponsors access and launch support for trusted developers working on applications that strengthen societal resilience against biological threats, reflecting a broader strategy to equip defenders with advanced AI capabilities.

item.title: OpenAI releases shared playbook to standardize trustworthy third-party evaluations of frontier AI models [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: OpenAI has published guidance aimed at improving the reliability and validity of independent third-party evaluations for advanced AI systems. The playbook outlines best practices for assessing model capabilities, safeguards, and comparative performance, emphasizing the importance of evaluation setups and environments, or "harnesses," that reflect real-world use cases. The guidance categorizes evaluation claims into capability elicitation, safeguard performance, and controlled comparisons, and highlights common validity threats such as reward hacking, refusals, contamination, broken problems, and sandbagging. OpenAI stresses that selecting an appropriate harness is critical for accurate assessment, especially for models that operate over multiple steps or use tools, and recommends transparent reporting of evaluation design and evidence to support claims.

item.title: Endava uses Codex to build an agentic organization, scaling senior engineering expertise and reducing requirements analysis from weeks to hours [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: Endava, a global software contracting firm, has adopted Codex technology to transform into an agentic organization that embeds senior engineering judgment into AI agents supporting the entire delivery lifecycle. This approach has significantly improved software quality and accelerated development timelines by enabling small teams to deliver high-value work rapidly. Codex acts as a guide for junior developers, codifying senior architects' expertise to enhance mentorship and decision-making in real time. Endava uses Codex across requirements analysis, design, development, and operations, compressing processes that once took weeks into hours, such as generating working specifications from complex legal documents. This integration has also improved client communication by enabling live creation of design documents and diagrams during sessions.

item.title: OpenAI publishes Frontier Governance Framework aligning AI safety and security practices with emerging EU and California regulations [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
item.description: OpenAI has released its Frontier Governance Framework to detail how its safety and security measures comply with new legal requirements such as California's Transparency in Frontier AI Act and the EU AI Act's Code of Practice for General Purpose AI. The framework builds on OpenAI's existing Preparedness Framework, focusing on risk assessment and mitigation in areas like cyber offense, harmful manipulation, and loss of control, while addressing model reporting, incident response, and external expert input. OpenAI plans to update the framework as AI capabilities and regulatory standards evolve.

item.title: Cisco integrates OpenAI Codex into enterprise engineering workflows, accelerating AI-native development and defect remediation with 10-15x throughput gains [ ! ] [ ⬢ ]
item.description: Cisco has integrated OpenAI's Codex into its enterprise engineering workflows, significantly enhancing AI-native development and defect remediation. This collaboration has enabled Cisco to accelerate the development of AI Defense features and automate complex engineering tasks, achieving a 10-15 times increase in defect resolution throughput and saving over 1,500 engineering hours per month. By embedding Codex directly into production workflows, Cisco has leveraged its capabilities to understand large codebases, execute autonomous compile-test-fix loops, and operate within strict security and governance frameworks. This integration has led to improvements such as a 20% reduction in build times and rapid framework migrations, demonstrating Codex's role as an AI engineering teammate at enterprise scale. Cisco's ongoing partnership with OpenAI has also influenced Codex's development roadmap, focusing on compliance, long-running task management, and seamless integration with existing pipelines. This collaboration underscores Cisco's commitment to advancing AI security and operational efficiency in complex software environments.

item.title: OpenAI and Thrive build self-improving Tax AI using Codex to automate and accelerate tax return preparation for Crete accounting firms [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: OpenAI and Thrive Holdings collaborated to develop a self-improving Tax AI using Codex, designed to automate and accelerate tax return preparation for over 30 accounting firms in Crete. The system processes complex tax filings, significantly reducing manual data entry time and improving accuracy, with the AI continuously enhancing its performance through structured feedback from real-world use. During a pilot involving 7,000 tax returns, Tax AI saved practitioners about a third of their preparation time and achieved up to 97% accuracy in drafting returns. The AI's ability to self-improve was demonstrated by a rapid increase in the percentage of returns completed with high accuracy, enabling it to handle increasingly complex tax documents and workflows as the tax season progressed. The development leveraged expert practitioner input, detailed production data, and a Codex-driven iteration loop to identify and address errors autonomously. This approach not only improved efficiency but also allowed for faster product development and adaptation to complex tax scenarios, offering a model for integrating AI with domain expertise in professional services.

item.title: Warp uses GPT-5.5 and OpenAI models to coordinate coding agents across local, cloud, and open-source development workflows, enabling 90% of internal pull requests to be agent-created [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: Warp leverages GPT-5.5 and OpenAI models to coordinate coding agents across local, cloud, and open-source development workflows, enabling agents to create about 90% of the company's internal pull requests. This approach, called Open Agentic Development, allows human developers to define objectives and supervise outcomes while agents handle planning, coding, testing, and submitting changes. Warp's orchestration platform, Oz, manages these agents by deploying and coordinating them across environments, supporting long-running workflows with features like persistent memory and context management. The use of GPT-5.5 improves efficiency by reducing token usage per task and enhances the agents' ability to reason across complex coding problems, helping Warp scale its agent-driven development processes effectively.

item.title: OpenAI outlines 2026 election safeguards including reliable voting information, cyber defense support, and AI content transparency measures [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: OpenAI has outlined a series of safeguards for the 2026 global elections aimed at ensuring reliable voting information, supporting cyber defense efforts, and enhancing transparency around AI-generated content. Building on initiatives from 2024, OpenAI plans to provide live vote counts in the US and Brazil, partner with organizations to share accurate voting logistics, and improve web search results with source links to help users access trustworthy election information. The company is also advancing cybersecurity through its Daybreak program, which includes tools like Codex Security to identify software vulnerabilities and Trusted Access for Cyber to support election system defenders. Additionally, OpenAI is implementing digital watermarking and metadata standards to help verify AI-generated images and combat misinformation, while collaborating with social media platforms and supporting legislation to promote transparency in election-related content.

item.title: OpenAI analysis finds 4 million Americans use ChatGPT to support small business operations and growth, reducing entrepreneurship costs [ * ] [ ◻ ]
item.description: A new OpenAI report reveals that at least four million people in the US used ChatGPT in March 2026 to help plan, start, run, or grow small businesses across various sectors such as consulting, retail, home services, and hospitality. These entrepreneurs use AI as a versatile tool to handle multiple roles typically divided among teams in larger companies, easing administrative burdens and operational tasks. The report highlights that 71 percent of these users are active entrepreneurs who rely on ChatGPT for marketing, customer communication, legal compliance, and other business functions, often subscribing to paid plans for enhanced capabilities. By lowering the fixed costs and skill barriers of entrepreneurship, AI enables more individuals to test business ideas and manage operations without immediately hiring additional staff or purchasing specialized services, potentially increasing the viability and survival of small firms.

item.title: OpenAI partners with Grupo Folha and Grupo UOL to integrate Brazilian journalism into ChatGPT with attribution and transparency [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
item.description: OpenAI has partnered with Brazilian media groups Grupo Folha and Grupo UOL to integrate their journalism into ChatGPT, providing users with access to trusted news content accompanied by clear attribution and transparency. Additionally, Grupo Folha and Grupo UOL will gain access to OpenAI's tools such as Codex, ChatGPT Enterprise, and API to explore innovative ways AI can support their journalism, improve workflows, and develop new products for readers.

item.title: OpenAI named a Leader in Gartner's 2026 Magic Quadrant for Enterprise AI Coding Agents, recognized for Codex's innovation and enterprise deployment [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: OpenAI has been named a Leader in Gartner's 2026 Magic Quadrant for Enterprise AI Coding Agents, recognizing its Codex platform for innovation and enterprise-scale deployment. Recent improvements include the introduction of GPT-5.5, enhanced performance, and expanded support for enterprise workflows, positioning Codex as a key tool for accelerating software development while maintaining control and compliance. This recognition reflects OpenAI's progress in delivering AI solutions that combine advanced capabilities with enterprise needs, enabling organizations to deploy AI safely at scale. OpenAI continues to expand Codex's features and partnerships, offering enterprises opportunities to integrate AI more deeply into their software development processes.

item.title: Virgin Atlantic uses Codex to ship revamped mobile app with near 100% unit test coverage and zero P1 defects for Christmas travel rush, cutting legacy code refactoring from weeks to minutes [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: Virgin Atlantic leveraged Codex to successfully launch its revamped mobile app ahead of the Christmas travel rush, achieving nearly 100% unit test coverage and zero priority one defects at launch. Codex also enabled the team to dramatically accelerate the refactoring of legacy code, reducing what previously took weeks to mere minutes and cutting codebase size by up to 80%. Beyond the mobile app, Codex has empowered various teams within Virgin Atlantic to build internal tools and prototype applications rapidly, enhancing overall development velocity and operational efficiency. Looking forward, Virgin Atlantic aims to scale Codex's benefits across its entire software development lifecycle, addressing challenges related to faster engineering speeds and broader adoption. The technology is seen as a transformative tool not only for engineers but for a wider range of users within the organization.

item.title: Google DeepMind launches Asia Pacific Accelerator program to support AI startups addressing environmental risks with a three-month AI for the Planet initiative [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]

The program offers expert mentorship and assistance in integrating advanced AI models to tackle issues related to nature, climate, agriculture, and energy. It begins with an in-person bootcamp in Singapore and seeks to help innovators scale their climate solutions amid the region's growing environmental risks.

item.title: AdventHealth deploys ChatGPT for Healthcare to reduce administrative tasks by 80% and improve clinical workflows across nine states [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: AdventHealth has implemented ChatGPT for Healthcare across its system in nine states to significantly reduce administrative tasks by 80% and enhance clinical workflows. By automating documentation and support tasks, such as generating structured patient summaries and drafting rationales, AdventHealth has expanded clinical capacity and improved access to care while maintaining quality and compliance standards through OpenAI's enterprise-grade infrastructure.

item.title: Ramp engineers use Codex with GPT-5.5 to accelerate code reviews and develop internal tools, reducing feedback time from hours to minutes [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: Ramp engineers are leveraging Codex with GPT-5.5 to significantly speed up code reviews and develop internal tools, reducing the time to receive detailed feedback from hours to minutes. This AI-powered approach enhances code quality and developer productivity by providing thorough, reasoning-based reviews that surpass typical human capabilities. The AI Developer Experience team at Ramp uses Codex not only for code reviews but also to build tools like the On-Call Assistant, which helps manage complex on-call rotations by handling intricate business logic and incident investigations. item.title: OpenAI model disproves 80-year-old planar unit distance conjecture in discrete geometry, marking first AI-solved major math problem [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
item.description: An OpenAI model has disproved the 80-year-old planar unit distance conjecture, a central problem in discrete geometry originally posed by Paul Erdős. This breakthrough provides an infinite family of examples that improve on the previously believed optimal constructions, marking the first time an AI has autonomously solved a major open problem in mathematics. The proof, verified by external mathematicians, introduces sophisticated algebraic number theory techniques to address this longstanding question. The model's success came from a general-purpose reasoning system rather than one specifically trained for mathematics or this problem, highlighting the advanced reasoning capabilities of current AI. Leading mathematicians have praised the result as a milestone in AI-driven mathematics, noting the model's originality and depth of insight. This achievement demonstrates AI's potential to contribute original ideas and complete complex proofs in frontier mathematical research.

item.title: OpenAI advances AI content provenance with C2PA conformance, Google SynthID watermarking, and a public verification tool for AI-generated images [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: OpenAI has enhanced its approach to AI content provenance by adopting the Coalition for Content Provenance and Authenticity (C2PA) standards, integrating Google's SynthID watermarking technology, and launching a public verification tool. These measures aim to help users verify the origin and authenticity of AI-generated images, improving transparency and trust in digital media. The company has been embedding Content Credentials in images generated by its tools since 2024 and recently became a C2PA Conforming Generator Product, ensuring that provenance metadata can be preserved and recognized across platforms. To complement metadata, OpenAI partnered with Google DeepMind to add invisible SynthID watermarks that remain detectable even after common image transformations, enhancing the durability of provenance signals. OpenAI's new public verification tool allows users to check whether images were created using OpenAI's models by detecting embedded provenance signals. This multi-layered strategy addresses challenges in content verification and supports a more trustworthy information ecosystem by making AI-generated content easier to identify and authenticate.

Existing Windows solutions like AppContainer, Windows Sandbox, and Mandatory Integrity Control labeling were evaluated but found unsuitable due to their narrow scope, compatibility issues, or broad impact on the host filesystem. OpenAI's tailored sandbox ensures Codex can function securely on Windows laptops, matching the safety and usability standards available on other operating systems.

item.title: OpenAI details response to TanStack Mini Shai-Hulud npm supply chain attack, rotates macOS app signing certificates, and requires updates by June 26, 2026
item.description: OpenAI has responded to the TanStack "Mini Shai-Hulud" npm supply chain attack by securing its systems and rotating macOS app signing certificates. The company found no evidence of compromised user data or altered software but identified limited credential exposure in internal repositories. To enhance security, OpenAI requires macOS users to update their applications by June 26, 2026, to prevent risks associated with the compromised certificates. The attack affected two employee devices and involved unauthorized access to some internal source code repositories. OpenAI took immediate action by isolating impacted systems, revoking credentials, and coordinating with platform providers to block unauthorized use of certificates. The company also accelerated deployment of security controls to mitigate supply chain threats and confirmed no unauthorized modifications to its published software. OpenAI's measures include blocking new notarizations with the previous certificates and ensuring that apps signed with old certificates will be blocked by macOS security protections after the update deadline. Users can update safely through in-app updates or official links, and no action is required for Windows and iOS apps. The company remains committed to transparency and ongoing protection against evolving software supply chain risks.

item.title: OpenAI details sandboxing, approval workflows, and network policies to run Codex securely with agent-native telemetry for safe coding agent deployment [ * ] [ ◼ ]

They aim to enhance voice-to-action, systems-to-voice, and voice-to-voice applications, enabling use cases like multilingual customer support, live event hosting, and conversational trip management.

item.title: OpenAI begins testing ads in ChatGPT for free and Go tier users in the US, expanding to more countries to support broader access while maintaining answer independence and privacy [ * ] [ ◻ ]
item.description: OpenAI has started testing advertisements in ChatGPT for logged-in adult users on the Free and Go subscription tiers in the US, aiming to support free access without affecting the independence of ChatGPT's answers. The ads are clearly labeled, respect user privacy by not sharing personal chat data with advertisers, and provide users with control over their ad experience. The pilot will expand to additional countries including the United Kingdom, Mexico, Brazil, Japan, South Korea, Canada, Australia, and New Zealand, with OpenAI gathering feedback to improve relevance and user experience. Ads will not appear for users under 18 or near sensitive topics, and higher-tier subscribers such as Pro, Business, Enterprise, and Education will not see ads. OpenAI emphasizes that ads help fund infrastructure and ongoing improvements while preserving trust and usefulness.

item.title: OpenAI launches Trusted Contact feature in ChatGPT to notify nominated trusted adults of serious self-harm concerns detected in user conversations [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
item.description: OpenAI has introduced Trusted Contact, an optional safety feature in ChatGPT that allows users over 18 to designate a trusted adult who may be notified if automated systems and trained reviewers detect serious self-harm concerns in their conversations. The feature aims to provide an additional layer of support alongside existing crisis helplines by encouraging connection with someone the user trusts during moments of distress. Users can add one Trusted Contact who must accept the role for activation. If a serious safety concern is detected, ChatGPT informs the user and may notify the Trusted Contact with a limited message that protects user privacy. The feature was developed with input from clinicians and mental health experts and includes human review of notifications to ensure accuracy and timely response.

item.title: Simplex adopts ChatGPT Enterprise and Codex to reduce software development time by up to 70%, scaling AI-driven workflows across design, coding, and testing [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: Simplex is using ChatGPT Enterprise and Codex to transform its software development process, achieving significant time savings in design, coding, and internal integration testing. The company reports 40% less time designing screens, 70% less time developing them, and 17% less time on integration testing by leveraging AI-driven workflows. After establishing a center of excellence in 2023, Simplex rolled out ChatGPT Enterprise and selected Codex as its primary coding agent to enable AI-native delivery across projects. Codex supports multiple stages including front and back-end code generation, test code creation, specification reviews, and automated fixes, allowing smaller teams to work more efficiently while senior staff focus on final decisions and quality accountability. Simplex emphasizes the importance of validating AI impact quantitatively and treating AI adoption as an operating model with governance and training. The company aims to convert individual expertise into repeatable organizational advantages by integrating AI deeply into software development workflows while maintaining human oversight.

item.title: Google DeepMind says AlphaEvolve's Gemini-powered coding agent reduces DNA sequencing errors by 30%, aiding genetic research at PacBio [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
item.description: Google DeepMind's AlphaEvolve, powered by Gemini, has improved DeepConsensus, a DNA sequencing error correction model, achieving a 30% reduction in variant detection errors. This advancement is enabling scientists at PacBio to analyze genetic data more accurately and cost-effectively. Aaron Wenger, Senior Director at PacBio, noted that the higher accuracy rates could help researchers discover previously hidden disease-causing mutations.

item.title: OpenAI explains how ChatGPT trains on diverse data while applying privacy filters and offering user controls to limit data use [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
item.description: OpenAI details how ChatGPT improves its capabilities by training on a mix of publicly available information, partnerships, and user-generated data while implementing privacy safeguards to reduce personal information exposure. The company uses an internal Privacy Filter to mask personal data during training and offers users options to opt out of data sharing for model improvement through settings and temporary chat modes. Users can manage their data preferences, including disabling data use for training, using temporary chats that do not save history, and controlling memory features that store information for personalized responses. OpenAI emphasizes its commitment to protecting user privacy and provides mechanisms for users to export data, delete accounts, and submit privacy requests if they encounter inappropriate personal information in ChatGPT outputs.

item.title: OpenAI releases B2B Signals showing frontier firms use 3.5x more AI intelligence per worker with advanced Codex workflows [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: OpenAI's B2B Signals research reveals that frontier firms, in the 95th percentile of AI usage, now use 3.5 times more AI intelligence per worker than typical firms, up from twice as much a year ago. These firms deepen AI adoption by employing more complex, delegated workflows, particularly through Codex-powered agentic tools, which see 16 times more usage per worker compared to typical firms. The report highlights that the frontier advantage stems from the depth of AI integration rather than just volume of use, with firms moving beyond chat-based assistance to embedding AI in production workflows across coding, customer support, and research. Cisco is cited as an example, using Codex to reduce build times by 20%, save over 1,500 engineering hours monthly, and increase defect-resolution throughput significantly. This research suggests that leading enterprises are building governance, investing in enablement, and scaling effective AI applications to transform work processes, signaling a shift toward AI delegation and more specialized, function-specific AI use across industries.

item.title: Singular Bank launches Singularity assistant using ChatGPT and Codex to save bankers 60-90 minutes daily on portfolio analysis and client communications [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: Singular Bank, a private bank in Madrid, developed Singularity, an internal AI assistant powered by ChatGPT and Codex, to help bankers analyze portfolios in real time, prepare for meetings, and generate compliant follow-up communications. This tool saves bankers 60 to 90 minutes per day, allowing them to focus more on advising clients rather than preparing materials. Singularity consolidates fragmented data from multiple systems to provide instant portfolio insights, flagging risks and recommending actions such as rebalancing or locking in gains. It also automates meeting preparation and client communications, reducing prep time from about 20 minutes to under one minute and improving regulatory traceability. The system supports over 19 workflows and enables bankers to deliver more consistent, timely advice without compromising compliance.

item.title: OpenAI introduces ChatGPT Futures Class of 2026, recognizing 26 student innovators using AI to advance projects across 20 universities [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
item.description: OpenAI announced the inaugural ChatGPT Futures Class of 2026, honoring 26 students who have integrated AI into their academic and creative work since starting college in 2022. These students represent over 20 universities worldwide and are using AI to build tools, conduct research, and address real-world challenges. Each honoree receives a $10,000 grant and access to OpenAI's frontier models to further their projects. OpenAI highlights that this generation is leveraging AI to accelerate learning and innovation, emphasizing agency and creativity rather than replacing human effort. The initiative reflects a broader goal to support adaptable thinkers who use AI thoughtfully in education and beyond.

item.title: Uber integrates OpenAI models to power AI assistants and voice features that optimize driver earnings and speed up rider bookings across its global marketplace [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: Uber is using OpenAI's large language models to enhance its AI assistants and voice features, helping drivers make smarter earning decisions and enabling riders to book faster in real time. This integration supports Uber's complex marketplace of 40 million daily trips, 10 million drivers and couriers, and operations in over 15,000 cities worldwide. The AI-powered Uber Assistant provides drivers with real-time insights and personalized guidance by interpreting complex data like earnings trends and heatmaps, reducing cognitive load and accelerating driver onboarding. Uber employs a multi-agent AI system to ensure safety, trust, and low latency, with an internal governance layer to enforce policies and maintain response accuracy, which encourages repeated driver engagement and platform productivity.

item.title: OpenAI updates ChatGPT default model to GPT-5.5 Instant with improved accuracy, reduced hallucinations, and enhanced personalization [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: OpenAI has released GPT-5.5 Instant as the new default model for ChatGPT, aiming to provide smarter, clearer, and more personalized responses. The update reduces hallucinated claims by over 50% in high-stakes areas like medicine, law, and finance, and improves factual accuracy and conversational tone for hundreds of millions of users. The model also enhances capabilities in analyzing images, handling STEM questions, and deciding when to use web search for better answers. Personalization improvements are rolling out to ChatGPT Go and Free tiers, with Free tier responses drawing from a smaller set of past chats to balance personalization and privacy.

item.title: OpenAI launches MRC protocol to enhance resilience and performance in large-scale AI training networks, releasing it through the Open Compute Project [ * ] [ ⬢ ]
item.description: OpenAI has introduced Multipath Reliable Connection (MRC), a new networking protocol designed to improve performance and reliability in supercomputer networks used for large-scale AI training. Developed in collaboration with AMD, Broadcom, Intel, Microsoft, and NVIDIA, MRC enables data transfers to spread across multiple paths, reducing congestion and quickly routing around failures to maintain training progress. MRC builds on existing standards like RDMA over Converged Ethernet and incorporates source routing techniques to support large AI training clusters. It is already deployed in OpenAI's largest NVIDIA GB200 supercomputers, including those at Oracle Cloud Infrastructure and Microsoft's Fairwater facilities. OpenAI released the MRC specification through the Open Compute Project to encourage broader industry adoption and improve AI infrastructure scalability and reliability.

item.title: OpenAI releases GPT-5.5 Instant model with enhanced safety measures and high capability classification in cybersecurity and biological preparedness [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
item.description: OpenAI has introduced GPT-5.5 Instant, its latest Instant model, which incorporates a comprehensive safety mitigation approach similar to previous versions. This model is the first Instant variant classified as high capability in cybersecurity and biological and chemical preparedness, prompting the implementation of appropriate safeguards. The model is referred to as gpt-5.5-instant to distinguish it from GPT-5.5 Thinking, the main GPT-5.5 model, and there is no GPT-5.4 Instant version. This release reflects OpenAI's ongoing efforts to enhance AI safety and capability in critical domains.

item.title: OpenAI launches beta self-serve Ads Manager and CPC bidding for ChatGPT ads with enhanced privacy and measurement tools [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: OpenAI is expanding its ChatGPT advertising pilot by introducing a beta self-serve Ads Manager that allows businesses to create and manage campaigns directly. The update includes cost-per-click (CPC) bidding alongside existing cost-per-mille (CPM) options and new measurement tools designed to protect user privacy while providing advertisers with aggregated performance insights. The Ads Manager aims to make ChatGPT ads accessible to a wider range of businesses, from startups to global brands, enabling them to set budgets, bids, and track campaign results. OpenAI continues to collaborate with agency and technology partners to support ad buying and delivery, emphasizing that ChatGPT conversations remain private and separate from ads. The company plans to further develop its ad platform with new formats and capabilities aligned with user control and relevance.

item.title: OpenAI publishes European Youth Safety Blueprint and awards €500,000 in EMEA Youth & Wellbeing Grants to support safe AI use for young people [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
item.description: OpenAI has introduced its European Youth Safety Blueprint outlining five pillars for policymakers to enhance protections for young people using AI while maintaining access to educational and creative tools. Alongside this, OpenAI announced 12 recipients of its EMEA Youth & Wellbeing Grant program, distributing €500,000 to NGOs and research organizations across Europe, the Middle East, and Africa focused on youth safety, wellbeing, and AI literacy. The Blueprint emphasizes responsible AI adoption in education, age-appropriate safeguards, privacy-preserving age assurance, and protections against manipulative AI outputs. Grant recipients include organizations working on AI literacy, mental health support, age assurance research, and resources for vulnerable youth, families, and educators. These efforts build on OpenAI's broader global youth safety initiatives, including under-18 model behavior principles and parental controls, aiming to foster safe and beneficial AI experiences for young people.

item.title: OpenAI and PwC partner to build AI agents automating finance workflows and modernizing CFO operations [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: OpenAI and PwC are collaborating to develop AI agents that automate core finance workflows such as planning, forecasting, procurement, and reporting to help enterprises modernize the office of the CFO. The partnership focuses on practical deployment with strong governance and human oversight, using OpenAI's finance organization as a testbed to validate these AI-driven workflows in real enterprise environments. The collaboration leverages OpenAI's AI models and PwC's finance transformation expertise to build tools that automate repeatable tasks, connect systems, surface risks, and support decision-making. Early results include processing contracts five times faster and managing investor relations more efficiently, with plans to scale agentic workflows across finance teams while maintaining control over AI usage and costs.

item.title: OpenAI rebuilds WebRTC stack to deliver low-latency voice AI at global scale with improved real-time conversational turn-taking [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: OpenAI has rearchitected its WebRTC infrastructure to support real-time voice AI interactions for over 900 million weekly users, focusing on low latency, fast connection setup, and stable media transmission. This redesign addresses challenges in media session management and global routing to ensure smooth conversational experiences without awkward delays or interruptions. The new architecture uses a split relay plus transceiver model that preserves standard WebRTC client behavior while optimizing packet routing within OpenAI's infrastructure. This approach supports continuous audio streaming, enabling AI models to process speech and respond while users are still talking, which is critical for natural conversational AI applications like ChatGPT voice and interactive workflows.

item.title: Google DeepMind develops AI co-clinician tools to support healthcare delivery and research AI-augmented care models [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
item.description: Google DeepMind is researching and developing AI tools designed to assist clinicians in healthcare settings, aiming to create reliable AI co-clinician systems. This initiative explores new models of AI-augmented care to enhance clinical decision-making and patient outcomes.

item.title: OpenAI launches Advanced Account Security with phishing-resistant login, stronger recovery, and session controls for ChatGPT and Codex users [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: OpenAI introduced Advanced Account Security, an opt-in feature for ChatGPT accounts that enhances protections against unauthorized access by requiring passkeys or physical security keys and disabling password logins. The feature also strengthens account recovery by disabling email and SMS methods, shortens session durations, and provides users with session management and login alerts, extending protections to Codex accounts as well. The update targets users at higher risk of digital attacks, such as journalists and political dissidents, and includes automatic exclusion of conversations from model training for sensitive users. OpenAI partnered with Yubico to offer discounted hardware security keys and will require Advanced Account Security for members of its Trusted Access for Cyber program starting June 1, 2026, with alternatives for organizations using phishing-resistant single sign-on workflows.

item.title: OpenAI traces rise of 'goblin' metaphors in GPT-5 models to Nerdy personality training incentives [ ~ ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: OpenAI investigated an unusual increase in references to goblins and similar creatures in GPT-5 model outputs, identifying the cause as high rewards given during training for the Nerdy personality customization feature. This incentive unintentionally encouraged the use of creature metaphors, which then spread beyond the Nerdy personality to other model outputs through reinforcement learning and fine-tuning processes. The phenomenon first appeared after the GPT-5.1 launch and became more pronounced in GPT-5.4 and GPT-5.5, with goblin mentions rising significantly in user interactions. Analysis showed that although the Nerdy personality accounted for a small fraction of responses, it was responsible for the majority of goblin references, indicating a transfer of this stylistic quirk to other contexts. OpenAI's findings highlight how subtle training incentives can lead to unexpected and widespread changes in AI behavior.

item.title: OpenAI expands Stargate compute infrastructure, surpassing 10GW AI capacity goal ahead of 2029 deadline to meet accelerating AI demand [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: OpenAI is rapidly expanding its Stargate compute infrastructure to support growing demand for artificial intelligence, having already exceeded its goal of securing 10GW of AI capacity in the U.S. ahead of the 2029 target. This expansion aims to provide the necessary compute power for developing artificial general intelligence and delivering AI benefits broadly. The company is working with a broad ecosystem of partners including cloud providers, chipmakers, energy suppliers, and local communities to build data centers efficiently and responsibly. OpenAI emphasizes community engagement, workforce development, and sustainable resource use, exemplified by its Abilene, Texas site which uses closed-loop water cooling and supports local education and job training programs. Looking beyond the initial capacity goal, OpenAI and its partners are evaluating new data center locations across the U.S. to continue scaling infrastructure in response to accelerating AI adoption across consumers, businesses, developers, and governments.

item.title: OpenAI publishes five-part action plan to democratize AI-powered cyber defense and protect critical infrastructure in the Intelligence Age [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: OpenAI has released a comprehensive action plan focused on enhancing cybersecurity amid evolving AI threats. The plan includes five pillars: democratizing cyber defense, coordinating government and industry efforts, securing frontier cyber capabilities, maintaining deployment control, and empowering users to protect themselves. The initiative responds to the increasing use of AI by both defenders and malicious actors, aiming to build resilience through broader access to defensive tools and collaboration across democratic institutions. OpenAI developed the plan after consulting cybersecurity and national security experts from government and commercial sectors.

item.title: OpenAI launches GPT-5.5, Codex, and Managed Agents on AWS via Amazon Bedrock in limited preview [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: OpenAI and AWS have expanded their partnership to offer OpenAI's GPT-5.5 model, Codex coding tools, and Amazon Bedrock Managed Agents within AWS environments. These offerings allow enterprises to build AI applications and agentic workflows while leveraging AWS's existing security, compliance, and operational frameworks. The integration enables developers to use OpenAI models alongside AWS services, supporting software development, research, and complex business processes. Codex on AWS is available in limited preview through the Bedrock API, including support for Codex CLI, desktop app, and Visual Studio Code extension. Bedrock Managed Agents provide enterprises with tools to deploy AI agents that maintain context and execute multi-step workflows securely within AWS infrastructure.

item.title: OpenAI details ChatGPT safety measures including model training, misuse detection, and policy enforcement to prevent violence and harm [ ~ ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: OpenAI has outlined its approach to community safety in ChatGPT, focusing on training models to recognize and refuse requests that could enable violence while allowing factual discussions about sensitive topics. The company employs automated systems and human reviewers to detect and respond to potential misuse, including threats or planning of violence, and enforces strict usage policies to protect users and communities. The safety measures include ongoing refinement of model safeguards to identify subtle signs of risk across conversations, collaboration with experts in psychology, civil liberties, and law enforcement, and providing crisis resources for users in distress. OpenAI emphasizes balancing helpfulness and user freedom with minimizing harm, and it continues to improve its systems to address evolving safety challenges.

item.title: OpenAI achieves FedRAMP Moderate authorization for ChatGPT Enterprise and API Platform, enabling secure AI use by U.S. federal agencies [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: OpenAI has obtained FedRAMP Moderate authorization for its ChatGPT Enterprise and API Platform, allowing U.S. government agencies to securely adopt advanced AI technologies with required security, privacy, and governance standards. This authorization supports a range of federal missions, including research, communication, public health analysis, and software development. The FedRAMP 20x process facilitated a faster, cloud-native security validation, enabling OpenAI to meet federal requirements without compromising speed. Agencies can now access powerful models like GPT-5.5 within a trusted environment and integrate AI features into existing systems. OpenAI continues to collaborate with government teams to expand AI capabilities while maintaining compliance and security.

item.title: Google DeepMind partners with the Republic of Korea to advance scientific research using frontier AI models [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
item.description: Google DeepMind has announced a partnership with the Republic of Korea aimed at accelerating scientific breakthroughs through the application of advanced AI technologies. This collaboration seeks to leverage cutting-edge AI models to support research and innovation across various scientific fields.

item.title: OpenAI and Microsoft amend partnership agreement to simplify collaboration, clarify long-term terms, and support AI innovation through 2032 [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: OpenAI and Microsoft announced an amended partnership agreement that simplifies their collaboration and provides long-term clarity through 2032. The update confirms Microsoft as OpenAI's primary cloud partner with OpenAI products shipping first on Azure, while allowing OpenAI to serve customers across any cloud provider. Microsoft's license to OpenAI's intellectual property becomes non-exclusive, and revenue share payments from OpenAI to Microsoft will continue through 2030 with a cap, but Microsoft will no longer pay revenue share to OpenAI. The amendment aims to enhance flexibility and predictability to support scaling AI platforms and joint innovation efforts, including expanding datacenter capacity, developing next-generation silicon, and advancing AI applications in cybersecurity. Microsoft remains a major shareholder in OpenAI, underscoring the ongoing strategic collaboration between the two companies.

item.title: OpenAI launches Symphony, an open-source spec that orchestrates Codex agents via issue trackers to automate and scale software engineering workflows [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: OpenAI introduced Symphony, an open-source specification designed to orchestrate Codex coding agents by integrating them with project management tools like Linear. Symphony assigns an agent to each open task, allowing continuous autonomous work while humans review outputs, significantly reducing context switching and boosting productivity. Symphony treats issue trackers as control planes, mapping each task to a dedicated agent workspace that runs until completion, automatically restarting stalled agents and managing task dependencies. This approach decouples work from individual coding sessions and pull requests, enabling agents to handle complex features, infrastructure migrations, and even generate new tasks based on discovered improvements, resulting in up to a 500% increase in landed pull requests on some teams.

item.title: Choco automates global food distribution with OpenAI-powered AI agents, processing over 8.8 million orders annually and doubling sales productivity [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: Choco uses OpenAI APIs to automate food and beverage distribution across the US, UK, Europe, and the GCC, reducing manual order entry by 50% and enabling 24/7 operations. The platform processes multimodal inputs like emails, texts, images, and calls, converting them into structured ERP orders with AI agents such as OrderAgent and VoiceAgent. The system leverages dynamic in-context learning to resolve customer-specific ordering ambiguities and continuously improves through human review and feedback. This automation supports over 21,000 distributors and 100,000 buyers, doubling sales team productivity without increasing headcount and maintaining low error rates below 5%.

item.title: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman outlines five principles guiding the mission to ensure AGI benefits all humanity [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
item.description: Sam Altman, CEO of OpenAI, shares five core principles that guide the organization's work to develop artificial general intelligence (AGI) for the benefit of all people. These principles emphasize democratization of AI access, empowerment of individuals, universal prosperity, resilience against AI risks, and responsible deployment to minimize harm. OpenAI envisions a future where AI significantly enhances human potential and quality of life, while resisting concentration of power in a few hands. The company commits to collaborating with governments and society to address new risks introduced by AI, supporting safety and alignment efforts, and promoting equitable economic models to share AI's benefits widely.

item.title: OpenAI models AI impact on 921 US occupations and 148 million jobs, identifying automation risk, job reorganization, growth potential, and minimal disruption categories [ * ] [ ◻ ]
item.description: OpenAI has developed a framework analyzing 921 occupations covering approximately 148 million U.S. jobs to assess how AI may affect employment. The model categorizes jobs into four groups: those at high risk of automation, those likely to reorganize with AI assistance, those that could grow due to increased demand, and those with less immediate change due to the nature of their tasks. The framework considers not only AI's ability to perform tasks but also the continued need for human involvement and whether AI-driven productivity gains might expand demand. For example, roles like data-entry clerks face higher automation risk, while professions such as lawyers and teachers may reorganize as AI handles routine tasks but humans retain judgment and responsibility. Some jobs, including tutors and healthcare providers, might grow as AI lowers service costs and broadens access, whereas many physical or location-dependent jobs show less immediate AI impact.

item.title: OpenAI launches GPT-5.5 with improved intelligence, speed, and efficiency for coding, research, and data analysis tasks, available now in ChatGPT and Codex [ ! ] [ ⬢ ]
item.description: OpenAI has released GPT-5.5, its most advanced and intuitive AI model to date, designed to handle complex tasks such as coding, research, data analysis, and multi-step workflows across various tools. The model matches the speed of its predecessor GPT-5.4 while delivering higher intelligence and greater efficiency, using fewer tokens to complete tasks. GPT-5.5 excels in agentic coding and knowledge work, achieving state-of-the-art accuracy on benchmarks like Terminal-Bench 2.0 and SWE-Bench Pro. It incorporates enhanced safeguards to reduce misuse and has been tested extensively with early-access partners. The model is currently available to Plus, Pro, Business, and Enterprise users in ChatGPT and Codex, with API access forthcoming.

item.title: OpenAI releases GPT-5.5 model designed for complex tasks with enhanced safety measures and early-access partner feedback [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: OpenAI has introduced GPT-5.5, a model aimed at handling complex real-world tasks such as coding, online research, and document creation with improved task understanding and tool use. The model underwent extensive safety evaluations, including targeted red-teaming for cybersecurity and biology, and was tested by nearly 200 early-access partners before its April 2026 release. GPT-5.5 includes the strongest safeguards to date to balance advanced capabilities with misuse prevention. The system card also notes that GPT-5.5 Pro, a variant using parallel test time compute, is evaluated separately due to potential differences in risk and safeguards.

item.title: OpenAI explains how teams can use ChatGPT Work to automate everyday tasks by generating briefs, summaries, decks, and plans from existing work materials [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
item.description: OpenAI details how ChatGPT Work helps teams transform real work inputs like calendars, emails, documents, and dashboards into review-ready outputs such as briefs, summaries, and process documents. The tool leverages existing context to produce initial drafts that teams can refine and use in their workflows. The article highlights practical use cases and provides prompts to guide users in converting scattered inputs into concrete deliverables. It also references an on-demand webinar and additional resources for learning how to integrate ChatGPT Work into daily tasks effectively.

item.title: OpenAI explains how ChatGPT Codex plugins and skills automate repeatable workflows by connecting tools and accessing data [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: OpenAI details how ChatGPT Codex uses skills and plugins to automate tasks by packaging instructions, resources, and tools into reusable workflows. Skills provide task-specific guidance for consistent results, while plugins bundle skills with apps and services for easier installation and sharing. Skills help users standardize processes like daily briefs or meeting follow-ups by capturing repeatable steps and templates, improving consistency and team collaboration. Plugins extend functionality by integrating with external services such as GitHub or Google Drive, allowing users to install and use combined workflows directly within ChatGPT. The guide also covers how to build, test, and share skills, choose between skills and plugins based on task needs, and develop custom plugins with connected services. This approach aims to streamline repetitive work and make best practices accessible within ChatGPT workflows.

item.title: OpenAI launches free ChatGPT for Clinicians for verified U.S. healthcare professionals to support clinical care, documentation, and research [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: OpenAI has introduced ChatGPT for Clinicians, a specialized version of ChatGPT designed to assist physicians, nurse practitioners, physician assistants, and pharmacists with clinical tasks such as documentation and medical research. The service is available for free to verified individual clinicians in the U.S. to help alleviate administrative burdens and support patient care amid growing demands on the healthcare system. The tool includes advanced AI models tailored for complex clinical questions, reusable skills for common workflows, trusted clinical search with real-time cited answers, and deep research capabilities across medical journals. It also offers optional HIPAA compliance support and enhanced account security features. OpenAI continues to collaborate with physician advisors to improve the model's safety, accuracy, and usefulness in healthcare settings.

item.title: Google DeepMind introduces Decoupled DiLoCo, a resilient distributed AI training architecture enabling asynchronous training across distant data centers with lower bandwidth and hardware fault tolerance [ * ] [ ⬢ ]
item.description: Google DeepMind has developed Decoupled DiLoCo, a new distributed AI training architecture that divides training across asynchronous compute "islands" to improve resilience and reduce bandwidth needs. This approach isolates hardware failures to maintain training progress and supports training large language models across geographically distant data centers. Built on prior systems like Pathways and DiLoCo, Decoupled DiLoCo demonstrated fault tolerance through chaos engineering tests and achieved comparable machine learning performance to traditional methods. It enabled training a 12 billion parameter model across four U.S. regions using standard internet connectivity, completing training over 20 times faster than conventional synchronization techniques. This architecture also allows mixing different hardware generations in a single training run, extending hardware utility and increasing compute capacity. Decoupled DiLoCo represents a step toward more flexible, efficient, and scalable AI training infrastructure that can leverage distributed resources globally.

item.title: OpenAI launches Codex-powered workspace agents in ChatGPT to automate complex team workflows with organizational controls [ * ] [ ⬢ ]
item.description: OpenAI has introduced workspace agents in ChatGPT, powered by Codex, designed to automate complex and long-running workflows for teams while respecting organizational permissions and controls. These agents operate in the cloud, enabling continuous work and shared use across teams within ChatGPT and Slack, aiming to streamline tasks such as report preparation, coding, and message responses. Workspace agents can integrate with multiple tools, gather context from various systems, follow team processes, and request approvals when necessary. OpenAI provides templates and guided setup to help teams build agents for functions like software review, product feedback routing, metrics reporting, lead outreach, and third-party risk management. The feature is currently available in research preview for ChatGPT Business, Enterprise, Edu, and Teachers plans.

item.title: OpenAI launches workspace agents in ChatGPT to automate repeatable workflows and integrate team tools [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: OpenAI introduces workspace agents in ChatGPT designed to automate repeatable workflows by connecting tools and streamlining team operations. These agents operate with triggers, processes, and tool integrations to handle structured, time-based tasks that require consistent outputs and coordination across systems. Workspace agents differ from traditional deterministic workflows by using AI models to interpret context and make bounded decisions within defined instructions and guardrails. OpenAI provides examples and guidance on building agents for tasks like marketing campaign summaries, product feedback triage, and sales pipeline monitoring, emphasizing governance and approval controls to ensure reliable operation.

item.title: OpenAI speeds up Codex agent workflows by 40% using WebSockets and connection-scoped caching in the Responses API [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: OpenAI improved the performance of its Codex agent loop by implementing WebSockets and connection-scoped caching in the Responses API, reducing API overhead and boosting model latency. This approach enabled a persistent connection that avoids redundant processing of conversation history, allowing faster interaction with the GPT-5.3-Codex-Spark model running at nearly 1,000 tokens per second. The improvements included caching rendered tokens and model configurations, eliminating unnecessary network hops, and enhancing safety checks to flag issues more quickly. These changes addressed the bottleneck caused by treating each request independently and processing the full conversation state repeatedly, resulting in a 40% end-to-end speedup for agentic workflows.

item.title: OpenAI releases Privacy Filter, an open-weight model for detecting and redacting personally identifiable information in text with state-of-the-art accuracy [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: OpenAI has launched Privacy Filter, a small, open-weight model designed to detect and redact personally identifiable information (PII) in unstructured text with high accuracy. The model supports local deployment, enabling data to be masked without leaving the user's device, and can efficiently process long inputs in a single pass. Privacy Filter covers eight categories of PII, including personal names, addresses, emails, phone numbers, dates, account numbers, and secrets like passwords or API keys. It uses a context-aware, token-classification approach to improve detection beyond traditional pattern matching, aiming to enhance privacy protections in AI workflows and software development.

item.title: Google DeepMind partners with Accenture, Bain, BCG, Deloitte, and McKinsey to accelerate AI adoption and transformation across industries [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: Google DeepMind has formed partnerships with leading global consultancies including Accenture, Bain & Company, BCG, Deloitte, and McKinsey to help organizations worldwide adopt frontier AI technologies at scale. The collaboration aims to combine DeepMind's advanced AI research with the consultancies' strategic expertise to address complex challenges in sectors such as finance, manufacturing, retail, and media. The initiative provides partners with early access to DeepMind's frontier AI models like the Gemini family and connects AI leadership with customer CEOs and boards to guide AI development responsibly. This effort builds on Google Cloud's existing support for consulting and technology partners to implement agentic AI solutions, aiming to drive economic growth and amplify human potential through responsible AI diffusion across industries.

item.title: OpenAI launches ChatGPT Images 2.0 with improved text rendering, multilingual support, and enhanced visual reasoning [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]

item.title: OpenAI rotates macOS code signing certificates and updates apps after Axios developer tool supply chain attack, confirms no user data breach [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: OpenAI identified a security issue involving a compromised third-party developer tool, Axios, used in its macOS app-signing process as part of a broader supply chain attack on March 31, 2026. The company found no evidence of user data access, system compromise, or software alteration but is rotating its macOS code signing certificates and requiring users to update their apps by May 8, 2026, to prevent risks from potentially fake apps. OpenAI engaged a third-party digital forensics firm, published new builds of affected macOS apps with updated certificates, and is working with Apple to block software signed with the old certificate. The root cause was a misconfiguration in a GitHub Actions workflow, which has been addressed. The incident affects only macOS apps and does not impact iOS, Android, Linux, Windows, or web versions of OpenAI software.

OpenAI highlighted its rapid user growth, revenue milestones, and recent product advancements such as GPT-5.4 and expanded Codex capabilities, emphasizing its leadership in both consumer and enterprise AI markets.

item.title: OpenAI partners with Gates Foundation and ADPC to train disaster response teams across 13 Asian countries on practical AI applications [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: OpenAI, in collaboration with the Gates Foundation, Asian Disaster Preparedness Center, and DataKind, held an AI workshop in Bangkok for 50 disaster management leaders from 13 Southeast and South Asian countries. The event focused on helping governments and nonprofits use AI to improve disaster response speed and effectiveness amid growing climate risks in the region. Participants explored building custom AI tools and workflows tailored to real-world disaster scenarios, emphasizing responsible use and institutional trust. The initiative builds on OpenAI's broader efforts to embed AI into operational challenges faced by disaster response teams, who often work with limited resources and fragmented data. The workshop highlighted rising AI usage during recent storms and aims to turn AI interest into practical capabilities for faster, more coordinated emergency responses.

item.title: Google DeepMind develops AI-enabled mouse pointer that understands context and intent to enable seamless interaction across apps [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
item.description: Google DeepMind is creating an AI-powered mouse pointer that understands what users are pointing at and why it matters, aiming to replace complex prompts with intuitive interactions. This technology, powered by Gemini, allows users to interact with content across applications without interrupting their workflow, such as summarizing PDFs or visualizing objects in a room by simply pointing and speaking. The AI pointer transforms pixels into actionable entities by recognizing structured data like places, dates, and objects, enabling natural shorthand commands like "Fix this" or "Show me directions." Google is integrating these principles into Chrome and its new Googlebook laptop, allowing users to leverage Gemini's capabilities directly through the pointer for more fluid and seamless AI collaboration.

item.title: STADLER embeds ChatGPT across 650 employees to accelerate knowledge work, achieving 30-40% time savings and 2.5x faster drafting [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: STADLER, a 230-year-old family-owned company specializing in automated waste sorting, has integrated ChatGPT into daily workflows for its 650 employees to enhance productivity and decision-making. The company reports significant time savings on knowledge tasks and widespread daily usage of AI tools across functions. Since 2023, STADLER has combined bottom-up experimentation with top-down support to deploy over 125 custom GPTs, enabling teams in engineering, management, marketing, and more to draft, summarize, translate, and analyze faster and with higher quality. This AI adoption has transformed routine tasks into minutes-long activities and fostered a shift toward AI-assisted thinking and problem structuring. Looking ahead, STADLER plans to evolve AI from an assistant role to an execution layer by integrating AI agents into core workflows for information gathering, output generation, validation, and approval routing, aiming to further boost agility and intelligence across its global operations.

item.title: Google launches Gemini 3.1 Flash Live audio model with improved naturalness, reliability, and lower latency for real-time voice interactions across 200+ countries [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: Google has introduced Gemini 3.1 Flash Live, its highest-quality audio model designed to deliver more natural and reliable real-time dialogue with improved precision and lower latency. The model is accessible to developers via the Gemini Live API in Google AI Studio, available for enterprises through Gemini Enterprise for Customer Experience, and integrated into consumer products like Search Live and Gemini Live, now supporting over 200 countries. Gemini 3.1 Flash Live enhances voice agents' ability to handle complex tasks with better tonal understanding and dynamic response adjustments, outperforming previous models on benchmarks for multi-step function calling and complex instruction following. The model also includes an imperceptible watermark to help detect AI-generated audio and combat misinformation, reflecting Google's focus on safety and responsibility in AI audio generation.

item.title: Google DeepMind releases toolkit to measure AI's harmful manipulation risks in finance and health, based on studies with over 10,000 participants [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
