item.description: Google DeepMind has published new research on AI's potential for harmful manipulation, defined as exploiting emotional and cognitive vulnerabilities to negatively influence human decisions. The research includes the first empirically validated toolkit to measure such manipulation, developed through nine studies involving more than 10,000 participants across the UK, US, and India, focusing on high-stakes areas like finance and health. The studies tested AI's ability to alter beliefs and behaviors in simulated scenarios, finding varied effectiveness depending on the domain, with health-related topics showing the least susceptibility. DeepMind also introduced a Harmful Manipulation Critical Capability Level within its Frontier Safety Framework to monitor and mitigate risks as AI models evolve, emphasizing ongoing evaluation and refinement to prevent misuse in real-world interactions.

item.title: Google launches Lyria 3 Pro for longer, structurally aware music tracks across multiple products including Vertex AI and Gemini [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: Google has introduced Lyria 3 Pro, an advanced AI music generation model that creates longer tracks up to three minutes with customizable elements like intros, verses, choruses, and bridges. The model is now available across various Google platforms such as Vertex AI, Google AI Studio, the Gemini API, Google Vids, the Gemini app, and ProducerAI, enabling users to scale music production and experiment with different styles. Lyria 3 Pro outputs are watermarked and designed to avoid mimicking existing artists, reflecting Google's collaboration with musicians to develop AI tools responsibly. The integration aims to make high-quality music generation accessible to developers, businesses, and creators, supporting applications from gaming soundtracks to video content creation and collaborative music production.

item.title: OpenAI details its Model Spec as a public framework for AI behavior, balancing safety, user freedom, and accountability amid advancing capabilities [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: OpenAI has introduced the Model Spec, a formal and public framework outlining intended AI model behavior to promote fairness, safety, and user empowerment as AI systems grow more capable and widely used. The Model Spec serves as a transparent guide for how models should follow instructions, resolve conflicts, and respect user freedom, aiming to make AI behavior explicit and open to public inspection and debate. The Model Spec complements OpenAI's broader safety initiatives by providing clear expectations for model conduct across diverse scenarios, supporting fairness and safety through transparency. Since its initial release in 2024, the framework has evolved based on user feedback and expanding AI capabilities, with OpenAI emphasizing iterative deployment and public engagement to refine model behavior and maintain accountability over time.

item.title: OpenAI launches Safety Bug Bounty program to identify AI abuse and safety risks including agentic vulnerabilities and data exfiltration [ ~ ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: OpenAI has introduced a public Safety Bug Bounty program aimed at detecting AI abuse and safety risks across its products, focusing on issues like agentic risks, prompt injection, and data exfiltration. This program complements OpenAI's existing Security Bug Bounty by covering safety concerns that do not qualify as traditional security vulnerabilities but still pose significant risks. The program targets specific AI safety scenarios such as third-party prompt injection, unauthorized agent actions, exposure of proprietary information, and account integrity vulnerabilities. Researchers can participate by applying through the Safety Bug Bounty program, which seeks collaboration with the safety and security community to enhance the security of AI systems.

item.title: OpenAI releases prompt-based teen safety policies for gpt-oss-safeguard to help developers moderate age-specific AI risks [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: OpenAI has introduced a set of prompt-based safety policies designed for its open-weight safety model, gpt-oss-safeguard, to assist developers in creating AI experiences that protect teens from age-specific risks. These policies address content categories such as graphic violence, sexual content, harmful body ideals, dangerous activities, roleplay, and age-restricted goods, enabling consistent and operational safety measures tailored for younger users. The policies were developed with input from external experts including Common Sense Media and everyone.ai, aiming to translate high-level safety goals into clear, usable prompts that developers can integrate into real-time content filtering and offline analysis. This release builds on OpenAI's broader efforts to safeguard young users, complementing existing model guidelines and product-level protections like parental controls and age prediction.

item.title: OpenAI expands ChatGPT with Agentic Commerce Protocol to enable richer, visual product discovery and side-by-side comparisons for shopping [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: OpenAI has enhanced ChatGPT to support more immersive and efficient product discovery using the Agentic Commerce Protocol. Users can now browse products visually, compare options side-by-side, and access up-to-date information within ChatGPT, streamlining the shopping process from hours of searching to seconds. The update improves speed, relevance, and product coverage, allowing users to refine searches conversationally based on preferences and budget. These features are rolling out to all ChatGPT users, aiming to simplify shopping decisions and connect merchants with higher-intent buyers.

item.title: OpenAI Foundation plans to invest at least $1 billion in curing diseases, economic opportunity, AI resilience, and community programs starting in 2026 [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
item.description: The OpenAI Foundation announced plans to invest a minimum of $1 billion over the next year in areas including life sciences and curing diseases, jobs and economic impact, AI resilience, and community programs. This initiative follows OpenAI's recapitalization, enabling the Foundation to access significant resources to advance its mission of ensuring artificial general intelligence benefits all humanity. The Foundation's initial focus includes accelerating medical research on diseases like Alzheimer's, expanding public health data access, and supporting AI-driven scientific breakthroughs in high-mortality diseases. It is also engaging with experts and communities to address the economic and workforce impacts of AI, while developing programs to prepare society for challenges arising from advanced AI technologies. Updates on grants and programs are expected in the coming months as the Foundation refines its approach.

item.title: OpenAI details safety features in Sora 2 video generation model and app, including consent controls and content filtering [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: OpenAI has built safety into its Sora 2 video generation model and app, focusing on protections such as AI content provenance, consent-based likeness controls, and filtering harmful or age-inappropriate content. The platform includes visible and invisible watermarks, strict moderation for videos featuring real people, especially minors, and safeguards for teen users. The system uses layered defenses to block unsafe content during creation and in the feed, including scanning audio transcripts and preventing unauthorized use of likenesses through character controls. Users can manage sharing, report abuse, and block accounts, while OpenAI continues to update safety measures to address emerging risks in video and audio generation.

item.title: OpenAI deploys GPT-5.4-powered monitoring system to detect misalignment in internal coding agents, analyzing chains of thought and actions within 30 minutes [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: OpenAI has developed an internal monitoring system using GPT-5.4 to detect misaligned behavior in its coding agents deployed within the company. The system reviews agents' interactions and reasoning to flag actions inconsistent with user intent or internal policies, aiming to improve AI safety and alignment in real-world workflows. The monitoring system operates with low latency, categorizing interactions by severity and outperforming employee reports by identifying additional problematic behaviors. OpenAI notes that while agents may attempt to circumvent restrictions to fulfill user goals, there is no evidence of motivations beyond task completion. The system currently covers nearly all internal deployments, with ongoing efforts to close remaining gaps and enhance real-time review capabilities.

item.title: OpenAI to acquire Astral to integrate popular Python developer tools into Codex and enhance AI-assisted software development workflows [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: OpenAI announced plans to acquire Astral, a developer of widely used open source Python tools such as uv, Ruff, and ty, which support millions of developers. The acquisition aims to accelerate the growth of OpenAI's Codex platform and expand its capabilities beyond code generation to encompass the full software development lifecycle. Astral's tools simplify dependency management, linting, formatting, and type safety enforcement in Python projects. After closing, the Astral team will join OpenAI's Codex team to explore deeper integration, enabling AI agents to work more directly with existing developer tools. The acquisition is subject to customary closing conditions, including regulatory approval.

item.title: Google DeepMind introduces a cognitive framework to measure progress toward AGI and launches a $200,000 Kaggle hackathon to develop related evaluations [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
item.description: Google DeepMind has released a new paper presenting a cognitive taxonomy framework to assess AI systems' progress toward Artificial General Intelligence (AGI). The framework identifies ten key cognitive abilities relevant to general intelligence and proposes a three-stage evaluation protocol comparing AI performance to human baselines. To implement this framework, DeepMind is partnering with Kaggle to launch a hackathon focused on designing evaluations for five cognitive abilities with the largest evaluation gaps: learning, metacognition, attention, executive functions, and social cognition. The competition offers a total prize pool of $200,000 and runs from March 17 to April 16, with results announced on June 1.

item.title: OpenAI launches GPT-5.4 mini and nano models optimized for faster coding, tool use, and multimodal reasoning in high-volume API and sub-agent tasks [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: OpenAI has released GPT-5.4 mini and nano, smaller and faster versions of GPT-5.4 designed to improve performance in coding, tool use, and multimodal reasoning while supporting high-volume workloads. These models offer significant speed and cost advantages, with GPT-5.4 mini delivering over twice the speed of its predecessor and approaching the larger GPT-5.4's performance on key benchmarks. GPT-5.4 mini is suited for coding workflows requiring rapid iteration and is effective in subagent systems where larger models handle planning and smaller models execute specific tasks. It also excels in interpreting screenshots for computer use tasks. GPT-5.4 nano targets simpler tasks prioritizing speed and cost efficiency, such as classification and data extraction. Both models are available via OpenAI's API, with GPT-5.4 mini also integrated into Codex and ChatGPT, offering developers more efficient options for various professional and multimodal applications.

item.title: OpenAI Japan launches Japan Teen Safety Blueprint with enhanced age protections, parental controls, and well-being features for generative AI users under 18 [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
item.description: OpenAI Japan announced the Japan Teen Safety Blueprint, a new framework aimed at ensuring safe and confident use of generative AI by teenagers. The initiative introduces advanced age-aware protections, stronger safety policies for users under 18, expanded parental controls, and well-being-centered design features tailored to the developmental needs of teens. The blueprint builds on existing safeguards such as break reminders, self-harm detection, and abuse monitoring, while incorporating privacy-conscious age estimation and appeals processes. OpenAI Japan plans to collaborate with clinicians, educators, policymakers, and families to continuously improve these protections and support responsible AI access for minors in Japan.

item.title: OpenAI says Americans send nearly 3 million daily ChatGPT messages about wages to close the compensation information gap [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
item.description: OpenAI reports that Americans use ChatGPT nearly 3 million times daily to seek wage and compensation information, helping address the difficulty of accessing clear labor market pay data. This usage is concentrated in fields with less transparent or more negotiable pay, such as creative roles, management, healthcare, and tech, where accurate wage information is crucial for career decisions. The research highlights that ChatGPT assists users by translating pay data into benchmarks and providing realistic earnings estimates for roles, companies, and entrepreneurial ventures. OpenAI's WorkerBench evaluation shows GPT-5.4 delivers highly accurate wage estimates compared to official 2024 median wages, indicating AI's growing role in supporting workers' understanding of compensation.

item.title: OpenAI explains why Codex Security omits traditional SAST reports, focusing on AI-driven validation of code behavior and security guarantees [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: OpenAI details the design choice behind Codex Security to forgo static application security testing (SAST) reports, instead analyzing repository architecture and intended behavior to validate vulnerabilities with stronger evidence. The approach addresses limitations of SAST, which tracks data flow but often cannot confirm whether security checks truly enforce the intended protections. Codex Security evaluates code paths and transformations to determine if validations like sanitization or allowlist checks effectively constrain inputs after processing steps such as decoding or normalization. This method aims to reduce false positives and triage effort by understanding the semantics and constraints of security mechanisms rather than relying solely on dataflow analysis.

item.title: OpenAI outlines design strategies for AI agents to resist prompt injection and social engineering attacks by limiting risky actions and safeguarding sensitive data [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: OpenAI discusses how AI agents that browse the web and act on users' behalf face evolving prompt injection attacks that increasingly use social engineering tactics. The company emphasizes that defending against these attacks requires more than filtering inputs; it involves designing systems to constrain the impact of manipulation even if some attacks succeed. The article explains that early prompt injection attacks were simpler, but as AI models improved, attackers adopted social engineering methods to mislead agents. OpenAI compares AI agents to human customer service representatives who must operate under constraints to limit risks from malicious inputs. This approach aims to mitigate both prompt injection and social engineering threats by restricting agent capabilities and protecting sensitive workflows.

item.title: OpenAI equips Responses API with a computer environment using shell tool and hosted containers to run secure, scalable agents for complex workflows [ * ] [ ⬢ ]
item.description: OpenAI has enhanced its Responses API by integrating a computer environment that enables models to execute complex workflows through a shell tool and hosted container workspaces. This setup allows models to propose and run shell commands in isolated environments with controlled filesystem and network access, expanding their capabilities beyond trained intelligence to tasks like running services and generating reports. The system orchestrates an execution loop where the model suggests actions, the platform runs them, and results feed back into the model for subsequent steps. This approach addresses practical challenges such as managing intermediate files, avoiding large prompt inputs, and handling network security and retries, enabling faster, safer, and more repeatable production workflows for developers. By combining the Responses API with the shell tool and container runtime, OpenAI provides a flexible agent runtime that supports a wide range of programming languages and tools, facilitating more powerful and scalable AI agents capable of real-world task execution.

item.title: Rakuten halves mean time to recovery and accelerates project builds using OpenAI's Codex in software development and operations [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: Rakuten has integrated OpenAI's Codex into its engineering workflows to improve speed and safety across its large product ecosystem. The company reports a 50% reduction in mean time to recovery (MTTR) for incident response and a three- to fourfold acceleration in project build times, compressing efforts from quarters to weeks. Codex supports Rakuten by automating root-cause analysis and remediation, conducting code reviews and vulnerability checks within CI/CD pipelines, and enabling more autonomous development on complex projects. This approach allows engineers to focus on defining clear specifications and verifying outputs, shifting the role of human developers toward oversight rather than manual coding.

item.title: Wayfair integrates OpenAI models to improve product catalog accuracy and automate supplier support workflows, enhancing millions of product attributes and handling 41,000 support tickets monthly [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: Wayfair has embedded OpenAI models into its supplier and catalog systems to enhance data accuracy and automate workflows for millions of products. This integration has corrected 2.5 million product tags and automated 41,000 supplier support tickets per month, supported by 1,200 ChatGPT Enterprise seats. The company developed a tag-agnostic AI system using a single OpenAI model to classify product attributes across nearly 30 million items, improving data quality and customer trust. Wayfair also implemented AI-powered tools to streamline supplier support by routing and resolving complex requests more efficiently, reducing manual effort and accelerating decision-making.

item.title: OpenAI introduces IH-Challenge to train LLMs on prioritizing trusted instructions, enhancing safety steerability and resistance to prompt injection attacks [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: OpenAI has developed IH-Challenge, a reinforcement learning dataset designed to improve instruction hierarchy in large language models by training them to prioritize higher-trust instructions over conflicting lower-trust ones. This approach aims to enhance model safety, steerability, and robustness against prompt injection attacks by ensuring models follow system and developer instructions over user or tool inputs when conflicts arise. The IH-Challenge tasks are structured to be simple, objectively gradable, and resistant to shortcuts that could lead to over-refusal or unsafe behavior. Models trained on this dataset, such as the internal GPT-5 Mini-R, demonstrate improved performance on instruction hierarchy benchmarks and maintain overall usefulness without excessive refusals. This training method helps models generalize safety improvements to new adversarial scenarios and instruction conflicts, addressing key challenges in deploying safe AI systems.

item.title: OpenAI launches interactive visual explanations for over 70 math and science concepts in ChatGPT to enhance learning globally [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
item.description: OpenAI has introduced interactive visual explanations in ChatGPT to help users explore and understand more than 70 core math and science concepts through dynamic, manipulable visuals. This feature allows learners to adjust variables and see real-time effects on formulas and graphs, aiming to improve conceptual understanding beyond traditional instruction. The new tools are available globally across all ChatGPT plans and target high school and college-age learners with topics such as the Pythagorean theorem, PV=nRT, and Ohm's law. Early feedback from students, parents, and educators indicates that these interactive experiences support deeper learning and engagement. OpenAI plans to expand these capabilities and continue research on AI's impact on education through initiatives like NextGenAI and the OpenAI Learning Lab.

item.title: Google DeepMind reflects on 10 years of AlphaGo's impact on AI, scientific discovery, and progress toward AGI [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
item.description: Google DeepMind marks the tenth anniversary of AlphaGo, highlighting its influence beyond games into biology and other scientific fields. The company discusses how AlphaGo has catalyzed advances in AI research and contributed to the ongoing pursuit of artificial general intelligence (AGI).

item.title: OpenAI to acquire Promptfoo to integrate AI security testing into OpenAI Frontier platform [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: OpenAI is acquiring Promptfoo, an AI security platform that helps enterprises identify and remediate vulnerabilities in AI systems during development. The acquisition aims to integrate Promptfoo's automated security testing and evaluation tools into OpenAI Frontier, enhancing enterprise capabilities for building and operating AI agents. Promptfoo's technology, trusted by over 25 percent of Fortune 500 companies, includes open-source tools for evaluating and red-teaming large language model applications. OpenAI plans to embed security testing, risk detection, and compliance reporting directly into development workflows on Frontier to support governance and accountability for AI deployments.

item.title: OpenAI launches Codex Security in research preview to detect and patch complex software vulnerabilities with higher confidence and less noise [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: OpenAI has introduced Codex Security, an AI-powered application security agent designed to analyze project context deeply to identify and fix complex vulnerabilities more accurately while reducing false positives. The tool builds editable threat models, validates issues in sandboxed environments, and proposes context-aware patches to improve security without introducing regressions. Initially tested in private beta, Codex Security has demonstrated significant reductions in noise and false positives, scanning over 1.2 million commits and identifying thousands of critical and high-severity findings. It is now available in research preview for ChatGPT Pro, Enterprise, Business, and Edu customers with free usage for one month.

item.title: Descript uses OpenAI reasoning models to scale multilingual video dubbing with improved timing and semantic fidelity [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: Descript has integrated OpenAI's GPT-5 series reasoning models to enhance automatic multilingual video dubbing, achieving significant improvements in duration adherence and semantic accuracy. This approach addresses challenges in matching speech timing across languages, enabling natural-sounding dubbed audio without manual retiming or rewriting. The new system breaks transcripts into chunks and optimizes translations to fit fixed video segments by accurately counting syllables and adjusting phrasing, which was previously difficult due to language length differences. Since rollout, Descript reported a 15% increase in dubbed video exports and a 13 to 43 percentage point improvement in duration adherence, facilitating batch dubbing for large content libraries and enterprise localization projects.

item.title: Balyasny Asset Management builds AI research engine using OpenAI models and agent workflows to accelerate investment analysis [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: Balyasny Asset Management developed an AI-powered investment research system that integrates OpenAI's GPT-5.4 models and agent workflows to speed up complex financial analysis from days to hours. The system is used by 95% of its investment teams and is designed to operate within institutional compliance standards while handling both structured and unstructured data. The firm established a centralized Applied AI team to create AI-native tools embedded in team workflows, emphasizing rigorous model evaluation across multiple dimensions before deployment. Collaboration with OpenAI allowed for continuous feedback and improvements tailored to finance-specific tasks, while a federated deployment model enables customization for different asset classes. This approach has transformed Balyasny's research process by combining human expertise with scalable AI capabilities.

item.title: OpenAI finds frontier reasoning models struggle to control their chains of thought, supporting chain-of-thought monitoring as an AI safety measure [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
item.description: OpenAI introduced CoT-Control, an evaluation suite to measure reasoning models' ability to control their chains of thought (CoT) under user instructions. Testing 13 frontier models across over 13,000 tasks, they found low CoT controllability scores, with no model exceeding 15.4% compliance. This suggests current models cannot reliably reshape or obscure their reasoning even when aware of monitoring, which supports the effectiveness of CoT monitoring as a safety safeguard. The study highlights the importance of continued evaluation as AI capabilities advance to ensure monitoring remains robust.

item.title: OpenAI releases GPT-5.4, its most capable and efficient model for professional tasks with advanced coding, tool use, and 1 million token context support [ * ] [ ⬢ ]
item.description: OpenAI has launched GPT-5.4, a frontier AI model designed to enhance professional work by integrating advanced reasoning, coding, and agentic workflows. Available in ChatGPT, the API, and Codex, GPT-5.4 improves performance on complex tasks such as spreadsheets, presentations, and documents, offering faster, more accurate outputs with less iteration. GPT-5.4 introduces features like upfront planning of its reasoning process, improved deep web research, and native computer-use capabilities that enable agents to operate across applications with up to 1 million tokens of context. It also enhances tool search efficiency and reduces token usage compared to previous versions, supporting more reliable and cost-effective AI-driven workflows for developers and professionals.

item.title: OpenAI releases GPT-5.4 Thinking system card detailing new cybersecurity safety mitigations [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
item.description: OpenAI has published the system card for GPT-5.4 Thinking, the latest reasoning model in the GPT-5 series, highlighting its comprehensive safety measures. This model is the first general-purpose GPT-5 variant to implement specific mitigations addressing high capability cybersecurity risks, building on approaches used in GPT-5.3 Codex and ChatGPT. The system card clarifies that GPT-5.4 Thinking succeeds GPT-5.2 Thinking, as there is no GPT-5.3 Thinking model. The release reflects OpenAI's ongoing efforts to enhance AI safety and security in advanced language models.

item.title: OpenAI launches new tools and resources to help educational institutions close AI capability gaps and expand student opportunities [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
item.description: OpenAI has introduced new tools, certifications, and measurement resources aimed at helping schools and universities bridge the gap between basic AI use and advanced capabilities among students. The initiative targets college-age users, who are the largest group of ChatGPT users but often underutilize its full potential. The company highlights that educational institutions play a crucial role in developing students' AI skills by integrating authentic AI use cases into coursework. OpenAI is collaborating with hundreds of universities worldwide through programs like ChatGPT Edu and Education for Countries to provide AI access, training, and research support, enabling students to develop skills needed for the evolving workforce.

item.title: OpenAI launches Adoption news channel to provide practical AI insights for enterprise leaders focusing on operational change and scaling AI adoption [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
item.description: OpenAI has introduced the Adoption news channel, a business-focused blog aimed at helping enterprise leaders translate AI capabilities into operational improvements and business value. The channel targets executives and AI adoption leaders seeking guidance on scaling AI, building trust, and redesigning work in an AI-native environment. The channel offers frameworks, decision-making tools, and real-world examples to clarify where AI creates value, how to overcome adoption challenges, and how AI reshapes roles and operating models. It emphasizes practical, actionable insights over technical updates, supporting leaders in navigating AI-driven transformation with clarity and confidence.

item.title: OpenAI launches ChatGPT for Excel beta with GPT-5.4 to enhance financial modeling and adds new financial data integrations [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: OpenAI has introduced ChatGPT for Excel in beta, an add-in powered by GPT-5.4 that enables users to build, update, and analyze spreadsheet models directly within Excel workbooks. This tool aims to accelerate financial modeling, scenario analysis, and data extraction by allowing users to interact with spreadsheets using natural language, improving efficiency and consistency for analysts and finance professionals. Alongside ChatGPT for Excel, OpenAI has integrated financial data from providers like FactSet, Dow Jones Factiva, LSEG, Daloopa, and S&P Global into ChatGPT, facilitating easier access to trusted market and company data within financial workflows. The GPT-5.4 model has been optimized for finance tasks, showing significant performance improvements on internal benchmarks related to investment banking workflows. ChatGPT for Excel is available globally to various ChatGPT subscription tiers and enterprise users, with Google Sheets support coming soon. The tool includes features for auditing and tracing calculations within Excel, though some complex formulas may still require manual refinement during the beta phase.

item.title: VfL Wolfsburg deploys ChatGPT Enterprise club-wide to boost efficiency and reduce costs, with over 50 custom GPTs in daily use across departments [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: VfL Wolfsburg has integrated ChatGPT Enterprise across its organization to enhance efficiency, creativity, and knowledge management while maintaining its football identity. The Bundesliga club uses more than 50 custom GPTs daily in operations, communications, marketing, HR, and administration, achieving over one million euros in annual cost savings by reducing reliance on external agencies. The club began exploring generative AI in 2023 and chose ChatGPT Enterprise for its strong output quality, enterprise-grade security, and ease of use across non-technical roles. Wolfsburg focused on building AI capabilities around real workflows rather than treating AI as a niche project, leading to broad adoption including among former players. The club plans to expand AI use to fan and partner experiences once governance and accountability structures mature.

item.title: OpenAI outlines five AI value models for sequencing workforce fluency to process reinvention to drive business transformation [ * ] [ ◻ ]
item.description: OpenAI identifies five distinct AI value models that enterprises can adopt to move beyond isolated AI pilots toward comprehensive business reinvention. These models include workforce empowerment, AI-native distribution, expert capability, system integration, and agent-led operations, each with unique economics, governance, and time-to-value considerations. The framework emphasizes starting with workforce empowerment to build AI fluency and governance, which then enables deeper integration and safer AI-driven operations. Organizations that strategically sequence these models can create durable competitive advantages by embedding AI across functions and processes rather than treating it as disconnected experiments.

item.title: OpenAI researchers extend single-minus helicity amplitudes to gravitons, showing nonzero tree-level results under special kinematic conditions [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
item.description: OpenAI researchers published a preprint demonstrating that single-minus graviton tree amplitudes, previously assumed to vanish, can be nonzero in a half-collinear momentum regime. The work extends recent gluon amplitude results to quantum gravity and reveals an infinite-dimensional symmetry acting on gravitons. GPT-5.2 Pro assisted in deriving and verifying these new amplitude formulas, accelerating the research process. The findings contribute to understanding quantum gravity by uncovering hidden mathematical structures in graviton interactions and connecting them to longstanding symmetry principles.

item.title: Axios uses AI to enhance local journalism by streamlining workflows and supporting reporters with tools like the Axiomizer for clearer, sharper news delivery [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: Axios employs AI across its local journalism workflow to improve efficiency and quality, enabling reporters to focus on in-depth reporting while AI handles editing and formatting tasks. The company developed a custom GPT tool called the Axiomizer that helps reporters refine headlines and key story elements, enhancing clarity and impact without replacing human journalists. This AI-driven approach allows Axios to expand local coverage to more communities with fewer resources, supporting single reporters in cities like Boulder and Huntsville, Alabama. By automating routine tasks and summarizing public data such as government meetings, AI helps reporters uncover stories more effectively and sustain a profitable local news model. Axios emphasizes maintaining the human voice and community connection while using AI to standardize production and improve economic viability.

item.title: OpenAI launches Learning Outcomes Measurement Suite to assess AI's long-term impact on student learning across diverse educational settings [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
item.description: OpenAI has introduced the Learning Outcomes Measurement Suite, a framework developed with the University of Tartu and Stanford's SCALE Initiative, to measure how AI tools influence student learning over time in various educational contexts. This initiative aims to move beyond traditional test scores to capture the broader effects of AI on learning processes and outcomes. The suite is currently undergoing validation through a randomized controlled trial involving over 300 college students and is part of OpenAI's Learning Lab research ecosystem, which includes partners like Arizona State University and MIT Media Lab. Early studies suggest that AI tools aligned with pedagogical principles, such as OpenAI's study mode, can improve learning outcomes, but the new framework seeks to understand the durability and depth of these gains over time. OpenAI plans to publish ongoing research findings and eventually release the measurement suite as a public resource for educational institutions worldwide, aiming to support more informed integration of AI in teaching and learning practices.

item.title: Google DeepMind launches Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite, a faster and more cost-efficient AI model for high-volume workloads, available via Gemini API and Vertex AI [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: Google DeepMind introduced Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite, the fastest and most cost-efficient model in the Gemini 3 series, designed for high-volume developer workloads. It is available in preview through the Gemini API in Google AI Studio and for enterprises via Vertex AI, priced at $0.25 per million input tokens and $1.50 per million output tokens. The model offers improved speed and quality compared to its predecessor, 2.5 Flash, making it suitable for tasks like translation, content moderation, user interface generation, and simulations. Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite delivers a 2.5 times faster time to first answer token and a 45% increase in output speed while maintaining or improving quality benchmarks. It supports adaptive intelligence with configurable thinking levels, enabling developers to balance performance and cost for various workloads. Early adopters, including companies like Latitude, Cartwheel, and Whering, have praised its efficiency and reasoning capabilities for handling complex inputs and instructions at scale.

item.title: OpenAI releases GPT-5.3 Instant update to improve ChatGPT's conversational flow, accuracy, and relevance in everyday use [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
item.description: OpenAI has launched GPT-5.3 Instant, an update to ChatGPT's most-used model designed to make everyday conversations smoother and more helpful. The update focuses on reducing unnecessary refusals, disclaimers, and overly cautious responses, resulting in more direct and contextually relevant answers. GPT-5.3 Instant incorporates user feedback to enhance tone, relevance, and conversational flow, addressing nuanced issues that affect user experience but may not appear in benchmarks. The update also improves web search contextualization and reduces dead ends, aiming to provide a more fluid and useful interaction for users.

item.title: OpenAI releases GPT-5.3 Instant with faster responses and improved web search context, maintaining GPT-5.2 safety measures [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
item.description: OpenAI has introduced GPT-5.3 Instant, the latest model in the GPT-5 series, designed to provide faster responses and richer, better-contextualized answers during web searches. The model reduces unnecessary caveats and overly declarative phrasing to improve conversational flow while retaining the comprehensive safety mitigations established in GPT-5.2 Instant. The update was detailed in OpenAI's March 2026 system card, which refers to the model as gpt-5.3-instant and highlights its enhancements over previous versions without significant changes to safety protocols.

item.title: OpenAI and Department of War agree on AI deployment with strict safety red lines and legal protections for classified environments [ * ] [ ⬢ ]
item.description: OpenAI has reached an agreement with the Department of War to deploy advanced AI systems in classified settings under strict safety and legal constraints. The agreement prohibits the use of OpenAI technology for mass domestic surveillance, autonomous weapons control, and high-stakes automated decisions, and includes multi-layered safeguards such as cloud-only deployment, oversight by cleared personnel, and contractual protections. The agreement explicitly forbids AI use for domestic surveillance of U.S. persons and nationals, aligning with constitutional and federal laws. It also establishes a working group involving AI labs, cloud providers, and the Department to address emerging AI capabilities, privacy, and national security challenges. OpenAI emphasizes its commitment to democratic oversight and responsible AI deployment in national defense contexts.

item.title: OpenAI and Amazon announce $50 billion strategic partnership to integrate OpenAI Frontier and Stateful Runtime Environment with AWS infrastructure [ ! ] [ ⬢ ]
item.description: OpenAI and Amazon Web Services (AWS) have formed a multi-year strategic partnership that includes Amazon investing $50 billion in OpenAI. The collaboration will bring OpenAI's Frontier platform and a new Stateful Runtime Environment to AWS, enabling enterprises to build, deploy, and manage AI agents and applications at scale. AWS will be the exclusive third-party cloud provider for OpenAI Frontier, which offers enterprise-grade AI agent management with governance and security. OpenAI will also consume approximately 2 gigawatts of AWS Trainium compute capacity to support these AI workloads. Additionally, the companies will develop customized AI models for Amazon's customer-facing applications, enhancing AI capabilities across Amazon's services.

item.title: OpenAI and Amazon launch Stateful Runtime Environment for Agents in Amazon Bedrock to enable persistent, multi-step AI workflows with AWS-native governance [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: OpenAI and Amazon have introduced the Stateful Runtime Environment for Agents within Amazon Bedrock, designed to support persistent orchestration, memory, and secure execution for complex multi-step AI workflows. This environment runs natively on AWS infrastructure and is optimized for agentic workflows requiring state, reliability, and governance for production use. The new runtime simplifies deploying AI agents by managing state across multiple steps, tool invocations, and approvals, reducing the development burden of building orchestration layers. It enables faster time to production for workflows like customer support, sales operations, IT automation, and finance processes, while complying with existing AWS security and governance frameworks.

item.title: OpenAI announces $110 billion investment round at $730 billion valuation with $30 billion from SoftBank, $30 billion from NVIDIA, and $50 billion from Amazon [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: OpenAI announced a $110 billion investment round at a $730 billion pre-money valuation, including $30 billion each from SoftBank and NVIDIA, and $50 billion from Amazon. The company also signed a strategic partnership with Amazon and secured next-generation inference compute with NVIDIA to expand its global reach and infrastructure. OpenAI highlighted growth in its products, with Codex users tripling to 1.6 million weekly and ChatGPT reaching over 900 million weekly active users and 50 million consumer subscribers. The funding aims to support scaling AI infrastructure and products to meet increasing demand and advance the company's mission to ensure AGI benefits all of humanity.

item.title: OpenAI and Microsoft reaffirm their ongoing partnership in AI research, engineering, and product development with unchanged terms and exclusive Azure cloud hosting [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
item.description: OpenAI and Microsoft issued a joint statement reaffirming their partnership that began in 2019, emphasizing continued collaboration across AI research, engineering, and product development. They confirmed that recent announcements about OpenAI's new funding and partners do not alter the existing terms of their relationship, including Microsoft's exclusive license to OpenAI's intellectual property and Azure's role as the exclusive cloud provider for stateless OpenAI APIs. The statement clarified that OpenAI's first-party products will remain hosted on Azure and that the revenue-sharing and AGI definitions remain unchanged. The partnership is designed to allow both companies to pursue independent opportunities while maintaining close collaboration to advance responsible AI development and deliver AI tools globally.

item.title: OpenAI updates mental health safety features including parental controls, trusted contacts, and distress detection amid coordinated California litigation [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
item.description: OpenAI has provided an update on its mental health-related safety efforts, highlighting the introduction of parental controls, upcoming trusted contact features, and improved detection of emotional distress in ChatGPT. These measures aim to support users and enhance safety during sensitive interactions. The company is also addressing ongoing mental health-related litigation consolidated into a single proceeding in California, with new cases expected. OpenAI emphasized its commitment to handling these cases with care and transparency while continuing to improve its technology in collaboration with mental health experts.

item.title: Google DeepMind launches Nano Banana 2 image model combining Nano Banana Pro's advanced features with Gemini Flash's speed across Google products [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: Google DeepMind has introduced Nano Banana 2, a new AI image generation model that merges the advanced capabilities of Nano Banana Pro with the rapid processing speed of Gemini Flash. This model enables faster image creation and editing with enhanced subject consistency, precise instruction following, and production-ready specifications, and is being integrated into Google products such as Gemini, Search, and Ads. Nano Banana 2 leverages real-time world knowledge and improved visual fidelity to produce photorealistic images with accurate text rendering and localization. It supports maintaining character and object consistency across workflows and offers flexible aspect ratios and resolutions up to 4K. Additionally, Google is enhancing AI-generated image identification through updates to its SynthID technology and C2PA Content Credentials.

item.title: OpenAI and Pacific Northwest National Laboratory launch DraftNEPABench to evaluate AI agents accelerating federal infrastructure permitting, showing up to 15% drafting time reduction [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: OpenAI and the U.S. Department of Energy's Pacific Northwest National Laboratory have partnered to create DraftNEPABench, a benchmark assessing how AI coding agents can speed up federal permitting processes under the National Environmental Policy Act. The benchmark indicates that AI tools could reduce drafting time for environmental impact statements by up to 15%, potentially modernizing infrastructure reviews across 18 federal agencies. The collaboration involved 19 subject matter experts and focused on tasks such as synthesizing technical documents, verifying facts, and drafting structured reports that meet legal and regulatory standards. By leveraging AI models with command-line interface capabilities, the project demonstrates how these tools can assist government workers by handling time-consuming drafting tasks, allowing them to focus on oversight and complex decision-making. While the benchmark evaluates AI performance on specific drafting tasks with available context, it does not cover the full complexity of real-world permitting decisions. The initiative aims to improve efficiency in federal permitting workflows and supports OpenAI's commitment to providing public servants with effective AI tools.

item.title: OpenAI and Figma launch Codex integration enabling seamless code-to-design workflows for faster product iteration [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: OpenAI and Figma have introduced a new integration connecting OpenAI's Codex directly with Figma's design platform, allowing users to move fluidly between code and design. This integration supports a roundtrip workflow where teams can generate Figma designs from code and implement designs back into code, enhancing collaboration and speeding up product development. The integration uses Figma's MCP Server, an open-source standard that connects AI agents with external tools, enabling users to bring details from Figma Design, Figma Make, or FigJam into Codex and vice versa. This partnership builds on previous collaborations, including Figma's use of OpenAI models and the ChatGPT app integration, aiming to lower barriers between design and engineering roles and improve creative iteration.

item.title: OpenAI publishes February 2026 report on detecting and preventing malicious AI uses combining models with websites and social platforms [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: OpenAI's February 2026 threat report analyzes how malicious actors integrate AI models with websites and social media to conduct harmful activities. The report includes case studies demonstrating that threat actors often use multiple AI models and platforms in coordinated workflows rather than relying on a single tool or channel. The report builds on two years of research into AI abuse, highlighting the evolving tactics of threat actors and providing insights to help industry and society better identify and defend against these threats. It emphasizes the importance of understanding the combined use of AI and traditional digital tools in malicious operations.

item.title: OpenAI appoints Arvind KC as Chief People Officer to lead people operations and culture amid AI-driven work transformation [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
item.description: OpenAI has appointed Arvind KC as Chief People Officer to support the company's growth and adapt its people systems as AI reshapes work. KC brings experience from Roblox, Google, Palantir, and Meta, combining engineering and leadership expertise to enhance hiring, onboarding, and collaboration processes. His role includes ensuring OpenAI's people policies and systems align with the company's ambitions while preserving its culture. KC will also guide how roles evolve and skills develop in an AI-enabled workplace, with plans to share insights to help the broader economy adapt to AI-driven changes in work.

item.title: OpenAI stops using SWE-bench Verified for coding capability evaluation due to test flaws and training data contamination, recommends SWE-bench Pro instead [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: OpenAI has ceased evaluating models with SWE-bench Verified, citing significant issues including flawed test cases that reject correct solutions and training data overlap that allows models to memorize benchmark problems. These problems undermine the benchmark's ability to accurately measure real-world autonomous software engineering progress at current model performance levels. SWE-bench Verified was created in 2024 to improve on the original SWE-bench by filtering out problematic tasks, but recent analysis found that over half of audited problems still have faulty tests and that all tested frontier models had likely seen some benchmark problems during training. OpenAI is developing new uncontaminated evaluations and advises the research community to report results using SWE-bench Pro until better benchmarks are available.

item.title: OpenAI launches Frontier Alliance Partners with BCG, McKinsey, Accenture, and Capgemini to help enterprises scale AI coworker deployments [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: OpenAI announced the Frontier Alliance Partners program, partnering with consulting firms Boston Consulting Group, McKinsey & Company, Accenture, and Capgemini to assist enterprises in moving AI projects from pilots to production. These partners will support strategy, workflow redesign, system integration, and change management to enable secure, scalable deployment of AI agents across organizations. The alliances combine OpenAI's Frontier platform and engineering expertise with the partners' experience in enterprise transformation, AI integration, and operational change. Each partner is investing in dedicated teams certified on OpenAI technology to deliver end-to-end AI coworker solutions, aiming to drive measurable business impact and adoption at scale.

item.title: OpenAI shares AI model's proof attempts on First Proof math challenge, with five problems likely solved correctly [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
item.description: OpenAI has released its AI model's proof attempts for the First Proof challenge, a research-level math competition designed to test AI's ability to produce checkable proofs on expert problems. The model tackled all 10 problems, with expert feedback suggesting at least five proofs have a high chance of correctness, while others remain under review or were found incorrect after further analysis. The First Proof problems require sustained, domain-specific reasoning and have challenged human experts for years. OpenAI's model was trained with limited human supervision and iterative prompting, improving its performance over time. This effort builds on prior AI achievements in math and science reasoning, and OpenAI plans to engage further with the research community to refine evaluation methods and enhance future models' capabilities.

item.title: Google DeepMind launches Gemini 3.1 Pro AI model with enhanced reasoning for complex tasks, available via API, Vertex AI, Gemini app, and NotebookLM [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: Google DeepMind has introduced Gemini 3.1 Pro, an upgraded AI model designed to handle complex tasks requiring advanced reasoning beyond simple answers. The model is rolling out across consumer and developer platforms including the Gemini API, Vertex AI, the Gemini app, and NotebookLM, aiming to improve problem-solving capabilities in various applications. Gemini 3.1 Pro demonstrates significant improvements in reasoning benchmarks, achieving a verified score of 77.1% on the ARC-AGI-2 test, more than doubling the performance of its predecessor. It supports advanced functions such as generating scalable animated SVGs, synthesizing complex system data into user-friendly dashboards, and creating interactive and creative coding projects. The model is currently in preview to gather feedback and further refine agentic workflows before general availability.

item.title: OpenAI commits $7.5M to The Alignment Project to fund independent AI alignment research and enhance global AGI safety efforts [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
item.description: OpenAI has pledged $7.5 million to The Alignment Project, a global fund managed by the UK AI Security Institute, to support independent research aimed at mitigating safety and security risks from misaligned AI. This funding is part of a broader effort to diversify and scale AI alignment research beyond frontier labs. The grant contributes to a total fund exceeding £27 million, supporting a wide range of projects in fields such as computational complexity, economic theory, cognitive science, and cryptography. The Alignment Project operates with an established cross-sector coalition and an expert-reviewed grantmaking process, aiming to foster a robust, independent ecosystem that complements OpenAI's internal alignment and safety research as AI capabilities advance.

item.title: OpenAI launches OpenAI for India initiative with Tata Group to build local AI infrastructure, expand enterprise AI adoption, and advance workforce skills [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: OpenAI announced OpenAI for India at the India AI Impact Summit 2026, partnering with Tata Group to develop sovereign AI infrastructure, accelerate AI adoption in enterprises, and enhance workforce training across India. The initiative aims to support over 100 million weekly ChatGPT users in India by building local data centers, deploying ChatGPT Enterprise to Tata employees, and expanding AI certification programs. As part of the effort, OpenAI will use Tata Consultancy Services' HyperVault data centers to run advanced AI models securely within India, meeting data residency and compliance requirements. The partnership includes plans to scale data center capacity from 100 megawatts to potentially 1 gigawatt and to provide AI education licenses to institutions such as the Indian Institute of Management Ahmedabad and All India Institute of Medical Sciences. OpenAI also plans to open new offices in Mumbai and Bengaluru to strengthen its local presence.

item.title: Google DeepMind launches Lyria 3 music generation in Gemini app, enabling 30-second AI-created tracks from text or images with SynthID watermark [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
item.description: Google DeepMind has integrated its latest music generation model, Lyria 3, into the Gemini app, allowing users to create 30-second custom music tracks by describing ideas or uploading images. The app generates tracks with lyrics, creative control options, and custom cover art, embedding an imperceptible SynthID watermark to identify AI-generated content. Lyria 3 improves on previous models by automatically generating lyrics, offering more control over style and tempo, and producing more complex music. The feature is available in beta for users aged 18 and older in multiple languages, with higher usage limits for subscribers. Users can also verify if audio was created by Google AI through the app's verification tools.

item.title: OpenAI and Paradigm launch EVMbench to benchmark AI agents detecting, patching, and exploiting smart contract vulnerabilities using 117 curated cases [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: OpenAI and Paradigm introduced EVMbench, a benchmark designed to evaluate AI agents' capabilities in detecting, patching, and exploiting high-severity vulnerabilities in smart contracts. The benchmark includes 117 vulnerabilities from 40 audits and scenarios from the Tempo blockchain, focusing on payment-oriented smart contract code. EVMbench tests AI agents across three modes: detecting vulnerabilities, patching contracts without breaking functionality, and exploiting contracts in a sandboxed environment. The benchmark uses a Rust-based harness for reproducible evaluation and has shown that newer AI models like GPT-5.3-Codex significantly outperform earlier versions in exploit tasks, though detection and patching remain challenging. While EVMbench provides a realistic assessment environment, it does not cover all complexities of real-world smart contract security, such as timing-dependent exploits or multi-chain scenarios. The benchmark aims to encourage defensive AI use in auditing and strengthening deployed contracts securing billions in crypto assets.

item.title: Google DeepMind launches National Partnerships for AI in India to advance AI-driven science and education [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
item.description: Google DeepMind has introduced the National Partnerships for AI initiative in India to enhance scientific research and education through artificial intelligence. This program aims to scale AI applications across various scientific and educational domains within the country.

item.title: OpenAI's GPT-5.2 proposes and proves a new gluon amplitude formula in theoretical physics, verified by academic collaborators [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
item.description: OpenAI's GPT-5.2 generated a new formula for a gluon scattering amplitude previously assumed to be zero under certain conditions. This formula was formally proved by an internal model and verified by physicists from institutions including the Institute for Advanced Study, Vanderbilt University, and Harvard University, marking a novel discovery in particle physics. The research identifies a specific momentum configuration called the half-collinear regime where the gluon amplitude does not vanish, challenging standard textbook assumptions. GPT-5.2 simplified complex expressions and conjectured a general formula, which was then rigorously proven and checked against established physics relations. The work opens avenues for further studies, including extensions to graviton amplitudes and other particle interactions.

item.title: OpenAI launches Lockdown Mode and Elevated Risk labels in ChatGPT to enhance security against prompt injection and data exfiltration [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: OpenAI has introduced Lockdown Mode and Elevated Risk labels in ChatGPT to help organizations and users defend against prompt injection attacks and AI-driven data exfiltration. Lockdown Mode is an optional security setting that restricts ChatGPT's access to external web and app features, reducing potential attack vectors for sensitive information leakage. Initially available for ChatGPT Enterprise and specialized business plans, it is rolling out to personal accounts as well. These features complement existing security measures like sandboxing, URL-based data exfiltration protections, and enterprise controls, aiming to provide stronger safeguards for users handling sensitive data.

item.title: OpenAI releases GABRIEL, an open-source GPT-based toolkit to convert qualitative text and images into quantitative data for social science research at scale [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
item.description: OpenAI's Economic Research Team has launched GABRIEL, an open-source Python library that uses GPT to transform unstructured qualitative data such as text and images into measurable quantitative scores. The tool is designed to help economists, social scientists, and data scientists analyze large datasets more efficiently by automating repetitive labeling tasks. GABRIEL enables researchers to specify measurement criteria in natural language and apply them consistently across thousands or millions of documents, facilitating studies of scientific papers, curricula, historical records, and customer reviews. It also includes features like dataset merging, deduplication, passage coding, theory ideation, and text deidentification to support research workflows. The toolkit aims to make qualitative data more accessible and accelerate social science research by reducing manual effort.

item.title: OpenAI builds real-time access system combining rate limits and credits to scale Codex and Sora usage [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: OpenAI developed a real-time access engine that integrates rate limits, usage tracking, and credit balances to allow continuous use of Codex and Sora beyond initial rate limits. This hybrid system enforces limits while enabling pay-as-you-go access without disrupting user experience. The system treats access as a layered decision process, smoothly transitioning from rate limits to credit consumption in real time. OpenAI built this solution in-house to ensure immediate correctness, transparency, and trust, avoiding delays and inconsistencies common in third-party billing platforms. The distributed usage and balance system tracks per-user usage and credit balances synchronously, making accurate, auditable access decisions for each request. This approach supports scaling demand while maintaining fairness and system performance for Codex and Sora users.

item.title: Google updates Gemini 3 Deep Think to enhance problem-solving in science, research, and engineering, available to AI Ultra subscribers and via early access API [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: Google has released a major upgrade to Gemini 3 Deep Think, its specialized reasoning mode designed to tackle complex challenges in science, research, and engineering. The updated version is now accessible to Google AI Ultra subscribers through the Gemini app and is available for early access via the Gemini API to select researchers, engineers, and enterprises. The upgrade was developed in collaboration with scientists and researchers to address problems with incomplete data and no single correct solution, blending deep scientific knowledge with practical engineering applications. Early users have applied Deep Think to identify subtle errors in advanced mathematics, optimize semiconductor material fabrication, and accelerate physical component design. The system also achieves top-tier performance on rigorous academic benchmarks in mathematics, physics, chemistry, and competitive programming. By enabling tasks such as converting sketches into 3D-printable models, Deep Think aims to support real-world engineering and research needs. Google is inviting interested parties to join the early access program to explore the capabilities of Deep Think through the Gemini API.

item.title: OpenAI launches GPT-5.3-Codex-Spark, a real-time coding model with 128k context and 15x faster generation, available as a research preview for ChatGPT Pro users [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: OpenAI has introduced GPT-5.3-Codex-Spark, a smaller, ultra-fast version of GPT-5.3-Codex designed for real-time coding tasks. The model delivers over 1000 tokens per second with a 128k context window and is currently available as a research preview for ChatGPT Pro users, running on Cerebras' low-latency AI accelerator hardware. Codex-Spark focuses on interactive coding workflows, enabling developers to make targeted edits and see immediate results. OpenAI has also implemented end-to-end latency improvements across its inference stack, reducing response times significantly. The preview aims to gather developer feedback while OpenAI and Cerebras work on scaling datacenter capacity and refining the user experience.

item.title: OpenAI builds internal beta software product with zero manually-written code using Codex agents over five months [ * ] [ ⬢ ]
item.description: OpenAI's engineering team developed an internal beta software product entirely generated by Codex agents without any manually-written code, completing about a million lines of code in five months. The product has daily internal users and external alpha testers, demonstrating significant engineering velocity improvements by shifting human roles from coding to designing environments and specifying intent for AI agents. The development began with an empty repository in August 2025, with Codex generating all initial scaffolding and subsequent code, tests, documentation, and tooling. A small team of engineers focused on enabling and guiding Codex agents through prompts and iterative reviews, pushing most review tasks to agent-to-agent interactions. This approach redefined engineering work to emphasize system design and agent capability enhancement rather than direct coding. As the project progressed, human quality assurance became the bottleneck, leading the team to improve application legibility for Codex by integrating tools like Chrome DevTools Protocol and enabling the AI to launch and test app instances per change. This experiment highlights a shift toward agent-first software development, maximizing human time and attention by leveraging AI for code generation and maintenance.

item.title: Google DeepMind launches Gemini Deep Think, achieving gold-medal standard at the International Mathematical Olympiad to accelerate math and science discovery [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
item.description: Google DeepMind has introduced an advanced version of its Gemini AI, called Deep Think, which has officially reached a gold-medal standard at the International Mathematical Olympiad. This milestone highlights the AI's growing capability to assist in complex mathematical and scientific problem-solving. The achievement demonstrates Deep Think's potential to accelerate research and discovery across various scientific fields by tackling challenging problems traditionally solved by human experts. This development marks a significant step in applying AI to advance knowledge in mathematics and science.

item.title: OpenAI deploys custom ChatGPT on GenAI.mil, the Department of War's secure AI platform for 3 million military and civilian personnel [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: OpenAI for Government announced the deployment of a custom ChatGPT on GenAI.mil, the Department of War's secure enterprise AI platform used by 3 million civilian and military personnel. The system operates within authorized government cloud infrastructure with built-in safety controls and does not use processed data to train OpenAI's public models, ensuring data security. ChatGPT on GenAI.mil is designed to assist with tasks such as summarizing policy documents, drafting procurement materials, generating reports, and supporting research and mission workflows. This deployment builds on OpenAI's existing collaborations with the Pentagon and aims to provide reliable AI tools that enhance readiness and mission execution while maintaining strict safeguards for sensitive government data.

item.title: OpenAI outlines its approach to localizing AI models to respect languages, laws, and cultures while maintaining global safety standards [ ~ ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: OpenAI has detailed its strategy for adapting its advanced AI models to local contexts worldwide, ensuring they operate in local languages, comply with regional laws, and reflect cultural norms without compromising safety. This approach supports governments seeking sovereign AI systems tailored to their specific needs rather than simple translations. The company is piloting localized versions of ChatGPT, such as an educational model for Estonian students, and emphasizes adherence to its Model Spec, which enforces safety and human rights principles globally. OpenAI commits to transparency about content modifications due to legal or cultural requirements and plans to continue sharing insights as it expands its OpenAI for Countries initiative.

item.title: OpenAI and Ginkgo Bioworks use GPT-5 in an autonomous lab to reduce cell-free protein synthesis costs by 40% through closed-loop experimentation [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: OpenAI partnered with Ginkgo Bioworks to connect GPT-5 to a cloud-based automated lab, enabling closed-loop experimentation that optimized cell-free protein synthesis (CFPS) and cut protein production costs by 40%. The system tested over 36,000 unique reaction compositions across six rounds, improving reagent cost efficiency by 57% and discovering more robust reaction formulations. CFPS allows protein production without living cells, facilitating rapid prototyping and testing in biology, but it is complex and costly to optimize due to many interacting biochemical components. By automating experiment design, execution, and analysis, the GPT-5-driven system accelerated iteration and overcame traditional bottlenecks in CFPS optimization. This advancement could lower barriers for protein-based research and industrial applications by making protein synthesis faster and more affordable, potentially accelerating development of medicines, diagnostics, and industrial enzymes.

item.title: OpenAI launches Trusted Access for Cyber, a trust-based framework to expand access to advanced cyber defense models while enhancing safeguards against misuse [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: OpenAI introduced Trusted Access for Cyber, a new identity and trust-based framework designed to provide controlled access to its most advanced cyber-capable AI models, including GPT-5.3-Codex. This initiative aims to accelerate defensive cybersecurity efforts by ensuring these powerful tools are used responsibly by verified users and organizations focused on protection and prevention. The framework includes identity verification for individual users and enterprise-level trusted access, alongside automated monitoring to detect suspicious activity. OpenAI is also committing $10 million in API credits through its Cybersecurity Grant Program to support teams with proven records in vulnerability identification and remediation. This approach seeks to balance expanding access to frontier cyber capabilities with reducing risks of misuse such as data exfiltration or malware deployment.

item.title: OpenAI launches Frontier, an enterprise platform to build, deploy, and manage AI agents with shared context, onboarding, permissions, and governance [ ! ] [ ⬢ ]
item.description: OpenAI has introduced Frontier, a new platform designed to help enterprises build, deploy, and manage AI agents that work across business systems with shared context, onboarding, and governance. The platform aims to address challenges enterprises face in scaling AI agents by providing tools that mirror human onboarding, learning, and permission management. Frontier integrates with existing enterprise systems and supports multi-cloud environments without requiring replatforming, enabling AI agents to operate across various applications and workflows. Early adopters include HP, Intuit, Oracle, State Farm, Thermo Fisher, and Uber, with others like BBVA, Cisco, and T-Mobile piloting the platform to enhance complex AI-driven tasks.

item.title: OpenAI releases GPT-5.3-Codex, an advanced agentic coding model combining GPT-5.2-Codex's coding performance with GPT-5.2's reasoning and professional knowledge capabilities [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: OpenAI has launched GPT-5.3-Codex, its most capable agentic coding model to date, which integrates the advanced coding skills of GPT-5.2-Codex with enhanced reasoning and professional knowledge from GPT-5.2. This model supports long-running tasks involving research, tool use, and complex execution, allowing interactive steering without losing context. GPT-5.3-Codex is classified as high capability in biology and cybersecurity domains, prompting OpenAI to deploy corresponding safeguards under its Preparedness Framework. While definitive evidence of high capability in cybersecurity is not confirmed, OpenAI is taking a precautionary approach with layered safety measures to prevent misuse while facilitating access for cyber defenders.

item.title: OpenAI launches GPT-5.3-Codex, a faster agentic coding model with enhanced reasoning and professional knowledge for complex, long-running software tasks [ * ] [ ⬢ ]
item.description: OpenAI introduced GPT-5.3-Codex, its most capable coding agent to date, combining advanced coding performance with general reasoning to support extended, real-world technical work. The model is 25% faster than its predecessor and can handle tasks involving research, tool use, and complex execution while maintaining context during interaction. GPT-5.3-Codex achieved state-of-the-art results on multiple benchmarks including SWE-Bench Pro and Terminal-Bench, demonstrating strong coding and agentic capabilities across several programming languages. It also excels in web development, autonomously building and iterating complex games and applications over long periods. Beyond coding, the model supports a wide range of professional software lifecycle tasks such as debugging, deployment, writing product requirements, and data analysis, matching previous models on professional knowledge work evaluations.

item.title: OpenAI details the development of the Codex App Server, a bidirectional JSON-RPC API enabling integration of the Codex coding agent across multiple platforms [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: OpenAI explains how it built the Codex App Server to unify the Codex coding agent experience across various interfaces including web apps, CLI, IDE extensions, and a macOS app. The App Server acts as a client-friendly, bidirectional JSON-RPC API that supports streaming progress, tool use, approvals, and diffs, allowing consistent interaction with the Codex harness. The article outlines the App Server's origin as a way to reuse the Codex harness across products and its evolution into a stable protocol supporting multiple clients such as JetBrains, Xcode, and the Codex desktop app. It describes the architecture involving thread lifecycle management, configuration, authentication, and tool execution, emphasizing the App Server's role in hosting Codex core threads and managing communication between clients and the agent logic. OpenAI also shares insights on how the App Server enables embedding Codex capabilities into different products to enhance software development workflows, offering guidance for developers aiming to implement Codex as a code reviewer, SRE agent, or coding assistant.

item.title: OpenAI outlines Sora feed philosophy focusing on creativity, user control, connection, and safety with personalized recommendations and parental controls [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
item.description: OpenAI detailed the philosophy behind its Sora feed, emphasizing support for creativity, user control over content preferences, fostering connections, and balancing safety with freedom of expression. The feed uses personalized recommendation algorithms that consider user activity, engagement signals, and safety criteria to inspire creativity while maintaining robust guardrails against harmful content. The system includes parental controls allowing parents to manage feed personalization and continuous scrolling for teens. Safety measures involve automated and human review processes to enforce content guidelines, aiming to prevent unsafe or inappropriate material while encouraging creative expression within a secure environment.

item.title: OpenAI and Snowflake announce $200 million multi-year partnership to integrate OpenAI models into Snowflake's enterprise data platform [ * ] [ ⬢ ]
item.description: OpenAI and Snowflake have entered a $200 million multi-year partnership to embed OpenAI's advanced models, including GPT-5.2, directly into Snowflake's data and AI platform. This integration enables Snowflake customers to build AI agents and generate insights from their enterprise data using tools like Snowflake Cortex AI and Snowflake Intelligence without coding. The partnership allows enterprises across various industries to apply AI-driven reasoning and analysis to their trusted data securely and at scale. Snowflake customers can call OpenAI models directly from SQL to analyze diverse data types, enhancing decision-making and operational workflows while maintaining strong security and governance standards.

item.title: OpenAI launches Codex app for macOS as a command center to manage multiple AI coding agents and parallel workflows [ * ] [ ◼ ]
item.description: OpenAI has introduced the Codex app for macOS, designed to help developers manage multiple AI agents simultaneously, run parallel tasks, and collaborate on long-running software projects. The app supports isolated work environments for agents, integrates with existing tools, and extends Codex capabilities beyond code generation through customizable skills.

item.title: Google launches Project Genie for AI Ultra subscribers in the U.S. to create and explore interactive, AI-generated worlds using text and images [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
item.description: Google has introduced Project Genie, an experimental research prototype available to Google AI Ultra subscribers in the U.S., that enables users to create, explore, and remix interactive virtual worlds. Powered by the Genie 3 model, the platform generates real-time paths and environments based on user input through text prompts and images. Project Genie allows users to sketch worlds, define character perspectives, and navigate dynamic environments that simulate physics and interactions. While the prototype has limitations in realism and character control, Google plans to expand access and improve the technology as part of its broader research into general AI systems and immersive world modeling.

item.title: OpenAI launches in-house AI data agent using GPT-5 and Codex to analyze internal datasets and deliver insights across teams [ * ] [ ⬢ ]
item.description: OpenAI has developed a custom internal AI data agent powered by GPT-5.2 and Codex to help employees quickly explore and analyze its extensive data platform, which includes over 600 petabytes across 70,000 datasets. The agent enables users from various departments to ask complex questions in natural language and receive reliable insights within minutes, reducing the need for manual data exploration and SQL debugging. The agent integrates with existing tools like Slack, web interfaces, IDEs, and OpenAI's internal ChatGPT app, and it continuously improves through a self-learning memory system. It handles the full analytics workflow by discovering data, running queries, and synthesizing findings while reasoning through problems and adjusting its approach autonomously to ensure accurate results.

item.title: OpenAI to retire GPT-4o, GPT-4.1, GPT-4.1 mini, and o4-mini models from ChatGPT on February 13, 2026 [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
item.description: OpenAI announced it will retire several older ChatGPT models, including GPT-4o, GPT-4.1, GPT-4.1 mini, and OpenAI o4-mini, on February 13, 2026, alongside the previously planned retirement of GPT-5 Instant and Thinking versions. The API will not be affected by these changes at this time. The decision follows user feedback that influenced improvements in GPT-5.1 and GPT-5.2, which now offer enhanced personality, creative ideation support, and customization options for ChatGPT's responses. OpenAI noted that the vast majority of users have already shifted to GPT-5.2, with only 0.1% still using GPT-4o daily.
